sections.title: Solomon received wisdom from the Lord God as a gift.

verses.text: And Solomon, the son of David, was established in his kingdom; and the Lord God was with him, and he was greatly honored, and he prospered.
And Solomon spoke to all Israel, to the assembly of the leaders of hundreds, and to the captains, and to all the people of Israel, concerning all the matters pertaining to the house of the fathers.

And Solomon, along with all the assembly of Israel, went to the place where the Lord God had commanded, which was the tabernacle of witness that Moses had made in the wilderness, and they went to the altar that was at Gibeon.
But David had brought forth the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim; for it was prepared for her in the house of Jerusalem.
The son of Hur, the son of Uri, had made the altar of incense that was before the dwelling place of the Lord; and Solomon and the assembly of Israel sought the ark of the Lord.
And Solomon went out before the Lord, near the altar, and he offered there a thousand burnt offerings.
And that night, the Lord appeared to Solomon, and said, “Why do you ask of me what I give to you?”
And Solomon said to the Lord, “You have shown great mercy to my father David, and in him, you have made me king.”
Now, O Lord my God, since your servant is in the midst of this great people, which cannot be numbered nor counted for multitude, let your name be magnified.
Now, in the sight of this people, I come forth and enter in; grant me wisdom and understanding, for there is none able to govern this great people of yours.

And the Lord said unto Solomon, “Because this was in thine heart, and thou hast not asked for riches, wealth, or honor, nor the life of thine enemies, neither yet hast thou asked for long life; but hast asked for wisdom and knowledge for thyself, that thou mayest judge my people over whom I have made thee king.”

“Wisdom and knowledge will I give thee. And I will give thee riches, and wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had that have been before thee, neither shall there any after thee have the like.”
And Solomon came to Jerusalem from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the tabernacle of the congregation, and reigned over Israel.

sections.title: The Glory of Solomon

verses.text: And Solomon gathered chariots and horsemen; he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen, and he stationed them in the chariot cities and with the king in Jerusalem was the people.
The king also made silver and gold as plentiful in Jerusalem as stones, and he made cedar trees as abundant as sycamore trees that are in the lowland.
The horses which belonged to Solomon came from Egypt and from Kue; the king's merchants purchased them from Kue at a price.

And they brought up a chariot from Egypt for six hundred shekels of silver, and a horse for one hundred and fifty; and so for all the kings of the Hittites and for the kings of Syria did they bring them out by their means.

sections.title: Preparation for the construction of the house of the Lord.

verses.text: And Solomon said, "I shall build a house for the name of the Lord God, and a royal palace for myself."

And Solomon gathered together those who were to bear burdens, numbering seventy thousand, and those who were to hew stone from the mountains, numbering eighty thousand, and he appointed three thousand six hundred to oversee them.
And Solomon sent to Huram king of Tyre, saying, "As you dealt with my father David, and sent him cedars to build himself a house to dwell in, so do for me."

Behold, for Israel, for an everlasting name, as you have commanded before the Lord, to prepare the offerings of the burnt sacrifices, to dwell in the holy place, to offer the sacrifices morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and at the appointed feasts of the Lord our God, I, your son, shall build a house for the name of the Lord my God; and I will dedicate it to Him.
Our God, the Lord, is greater than all the gods; therefore, the house which I shall build shall be great.
But indeed, will God dwell on the earth? Behold, heaven and the heaven of heavens cannot contain You; how much less this house which I have built!

Now, with gold and silver, with bronze and iron, with purple and crimson, and with fine linen, as my father David prepared, I shall send you skilled men, who are wise to work with the skilled men of Judah and Jerusalem, whom my father David prepared.
Furthermore, I know that your servants know how to cut timber from Lebanon; therefore, I shall send you cedar and fir trees.
The house which I am about to build shall be exceedingly great and magnificent; therefore, prepare much timber for me, for behold, your servants will work with my servants.

Behold, I will give to your servants who cut timber, twenty thousand cors of crushed stone, twenty thousand cors of pure wheat, twenty thousand cors of pure wine, and twenty thousand cors of pure oil, I will give freely.
King Hiram of Tyre wrote to Solomon, saying, "The Lord hath loved His people, and He hath made thee king over them."

King Hiram of Tyre also said, "Let a skilled and wise son be sent to my lord, to prepare a house for the Lord and a house for his kingdom; blessed be the Lord God of Israel, who created the heavens and the earth."
Now, I have sent you a skilled and wise man, even Huram.

His mother is of the daughters of Dan, and his father is a man of Tyre; he is skilled in gold and silver, in bronze and iron, in stone and wood, in purple and blue, in fine linen and crimson; he is able to make all manner of engravings and to devise any plan that may be set before him. With your skilled men and with the skilled men of my lord David, he shall execute all that you desire.
And now, my lord, let him send the wheat and the barley, the oil and the wine, which he hath spoken of, to your servants.
And we will cut down from Lebanon, as much timber as you shall need; and we will bring it to you by sea in floats to Joppa, and you shall carry it up to Jerusalem."

And Solomon gathered together all the strangers that were in the land of Israel, after the numbering wherewith his father David had numbered them; and they were found to be a hundred and fifty-three thousand six hundred.
And he set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, and eighty thousand to quarry in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred to oversee them.

sections.title: Solomon built the house of the sanctuary.

verses.text: ሰሎሞንም እግዚአብሔር ለአባቱ ለዳዊት በተገለጠበት በአሞሪያ ተራራ ዳዊት ባዘጋጀው ስፍራ በኢያቡሳዊው በኦርና አውድማ በኢየሩሳሌም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት መሥራት ጀመረ።
በነገሠም በአራተኛው ዓመት በሁለተኛው ወር መሥራት ጀመረ።
ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይሠራ ዘንድ የጣለው መሠረት ይህ ነው፤ ርዝመቱም በዱሮው ስፍር ስድሳ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሃያ ክንድ ነበረ።
በቤቱም ፊት የነበረው ወለል ርዝመቱ እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሃያ ክንድ፥ ቁመቱም መቶ ሃያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ውስጡንም በጥሩ ወርቅ ለበጠው።
ታላቁንም ቤት በዝግባ እንጨት ከደነው፤ በጥሩም ወርቅ ለበጠው፤ የዘንባባና የሰንሰለት አምሳልም ቀረጸበት።
ቤቱንም በከበረና በተመረጠ ዕንቍ፥ በወርቅም አስጌጠው፤ ወርቁም የፋሩሔም ወርቅ ነበረ።
ቤቱንም፥ ሰረገሎቹንም፥ መድረኮቹንም፥ ግንቦቹንም፥ ደጆቹንም በወርቅ ለበጠ፤ በግንቦቹም ላይ ኪሩቤልን ቀረጸ።
ቅድስተ ቅዱሳኑንም ሠራ፤ ርዝመቱም እንደ ቤቱ ወርድ ሃያ ክንድ፥ ወርዱም ሃያ ክንድ ነበረ፤ ስድስት መቶ መክሊት በሚያህል በጥሩ ወርቅም ኪሩቤልን ለበጣቸው።
የምስማሮቹም ሚዛን ለእያንዳንዱ አምሳ ሰቅል ወርቅ ነበረ። የደርቡንም ጓዳዎች በወርቅ ለበጠ።
በቅድስተ ቅዱሳንም ውስጥ ከእንጨት ሥራ ሁለቱን ኪሩቤል ሠራ፤ በወርቅም ለበጣቸው።

The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long, fully extended; the length of one cherub's wing was five cubits, and it touched the wall of the house; the length of the other cherub's wing was also five cubits, and it touched the other cherub's wing.
The other cherub also had one wing that was five cubits long, and it touched the wall of the house; the second wing was five cubits long, and it touched the wing of the other cherub.
And the wings of these cherubim were twenty cubits long, standing on their feet; and their faces were directed toward the house of the Lord.
From the heavenly realm, from the crimson, from the deep red, and from the pure, He fashioned the dwelling place; and He also adorned it with cherubim.
In front of the house, their height was thirty-five cubits; they made the two pillars, and upon each of them was a capital of five cubits.
And they made chains like unto a net, and placed them upon the head of the pillar; and they made one hundred pomegranates and placed them upon the chains.

And the pillars were set, one on the right and the other on the left, in front of the temple; and the name that was upon the right was called Jachin, and the name that was upon the left was called Boaz.

sections.title: For the house of the Lord God, the holy servants who minister.

verses.text: And its length was twenty cubits, and its width was twenty cubits, and its height was ten cubits; this was the sanctuary that they made for Him.
And the inner sanctuary was twenty cubits long, and twenty cubits wide, and its height was ten cubits; and it was overlaid with pure gold.
And beneath it, around it, were the figures of oxen, ten cubits in number. And they were to be honored by it. And the oxen were arranged in two rows, standing together with the base in unity.

They made twelve oxen. Of these, three faced the north, three faced the west, three faced the south, and three faced the east; and the base that was made for them was upon them; and the back of all of them was inward.
Its thickness was a handbreadth; and its rim was like the work of the rim of a cup, like the flower of a lily; and it held three thousand baths.
Moreover, they made ten lavers for washing; and they set five on the right side and five on the left side, to wash in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
And they made the ten golden lampstands according to their ordinance; five on the right and five on the left in the temple.
And they made the ten golden tables, five on the right and five on the left in the temple. And one hundred golden bowls they made.
Moreover, they made the priests' court, and the great court; and the doors of the court were made of bronze.
And the base was set on the right side of the house, toward the east.
ኪራምም ምንቸቶቹንና መጫሪያዎቹን፥ በመሠዊያው ቤት ያሉ ማንኪያዎችንና የመገልገያውን ዕቃ ሁሉ ሠራ። ኪራምም ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ጨረሰ።
ሁለት ዐምዶችንና በሁለቱ ዐምዶች ላይ ጕልላቶችን፥ በዐምዶቹም ራሶች ላይ ያሉትን ጕልላቶች የሚሸፍኑ ሁለት መርበቦችን ሠራ።
በሁለቱም መርበቦች አራት መቶ የወርቅ ሻኵራዎችንና በዐምዶቹ ላይ ያሉትን ሁለት ጕልላቶች በሁለት ጎኖች የሚሸፍኑትን ሮማኖች ሠራ።
ዐሥር መቀመጫዎችንና በመቀመጫዎቹም ላይ መታጠቢያዎችን ሠራ፤
አንድዋንም ኵሬ፥ በበታችዋም ያሉትን ዐሥራ ሁለት በሬዎች ሠራ።
የእግር መታጠቢያዎችን፥ የእጅ መታጠቢያዎችን፥ ጋኖችን፥ የሥጋ ማውጫ ሜንጦዎችንና ኪራም የሠራውን ሥራ ሁሉ ከንጹሕ ናስ ሠርቶ ለንጉሡ ለሰሎሞን ለእግዚአብሔር ቤት አቀረበለት።
ንጉሡም በዮርዳኖስ ሜዳ በሱኮትና በሴድራ መካከል ባለው በወፍራሙ መሬት ውስጥ አቀለጣቸው።
ሰሎሞንም እነዚህን ዕቃዎች ሁሉ እጅግ አብዝቶ ሠራ፤ የናሱም ብዛት አይቈጠርም ነበር።
ሰሎሞንም በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ የወርቁንም መሠዊያ፥ ኅብስተ ገጽ የነበረባቸውን ገበታዎች ሠራ።
በመቅደሱ ፊት እንደ ሥርዐታቸው የሚያበሩ መቅረዞችንና ቀንዲሎችንም ከጥሩ ወርቅ ሠራ።
The lamps and their lampstands, the bowls, the snuffers, and all the vessels made for the service of the sanctuary, he made of pure gold.

The inner door of the house of the Lord was of gold, and the doors of the sanctuary were of gold, as well as the doors of the temple. Thus, all the work that Solomon did for the house of the Lord was completed.

sections.title: And the Ark of the Covenant entered into the house of the Lord.

verses.text: And Solomon, the son of David his father, brought in all the vessels of gold and silver, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and he placed them in the house of the Lord, in the treasury of the house.

At that time, Solomon gathered together all the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the chief of the fathers of the children of Israel, unto Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the city of David, which is Zion.
And all the men of Israel assembled themselves unto the king in the seventh month, at the feast.
And all the elders of Israel came; and the Levites took up the ark.
And they brought up the ark of the testimony, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and all the holy vessels that were in the tabernacle; even those did the priests and the Levites bring up.
And King Solomon and all the congregation of Israel, that were assembled unto him, were before the ark, sacrificing sheep and oxen, that could not be told nor numbered for multitude.
And the priests brought in the ark of the covenant of the Lord unto his place, into the oracle of the house, to the most holy place, even under the wings of the cherubim.
For the cherubim spread forth their wings over the place of the ark, and the cherubim covered the ark and the staves thereof above.
And the staves were so long that the ends of the staves were seen from the holy place before the oracle; and they were not seen without. And there they are unto this day.
And it came to pass, when the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, that the Lord made a covenant with them in Horeb, saying, "There shall not be any other god beside me."
And after they had departed from the temple, all the priests who were present were consecrated; and during their week, they were not permitted to serve.

And the singers, all the Levites who were present, along with Asaph and Heman, and the children of Jeduthun, with their brethren, stood in the east of the altar, arrayed in fine linen, having cymbals and harps and lyres, and with them were one hundred twenty priests blowing trumpets.

And the trumpeters and singers were as one, to make one sound to be heard in praising and thanking the Lord; and when they lifted up their voice with the trumpets and cymbals and instruments of music, and praised the Lord, saying, "For He is good, for His mercy endures forever," then the house, the house of the Lord, was filled with a cloud.
So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud; for the glory of the Lord had filled the house of God.

sections.title: The discourse that Solomon spoke unto the people.

verses.text: At that time, Solomon said, “The Lord: I will dwell in darkness.”
“And I have prepared a house for His name, a house that shall endure forever,” he said.
And King Solomon turned his face and blessed all the assembly of Israel; and all the assembly of Israel stood.
And he said, “The Lord God of Israel, may He be blessed, who spoke with His mouth to my father David and with His hand has fulfilled it.”

“Since the time I brought my people Israel out of Egypt, I have not chosen a city from all the tribes of Israel to build a house for My name, nor have I chosen a man to be a ruler over My people Israel.
But I have chosen Jerusalem that My name may be there, and I have chosen David to be over My people Israel.”
“My father David had it in his heart to build a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.”
“But the Lord said to my father David, ‘Because it was in your heart to build a house for My name, you did well that it was in your heart.’”
“Nevertheless, your son who will come from your body, he shall build the house for My name; but you shall not build it.”

And the Lord has fulfilled His word which He spoke; and the Lord has fulfilled it through my father David, and I have been set upon the throne of Israel, and I have built a house for the name of the Lord God of Israel.
"And I will dwell within it, the tabernacle wherein the covenant of the Lord was made with the people of Israel."

sections.title: The prayer that Solomon offered unto the Lord.

verses.text: And Solomon stood before the altar of the Lord in the presence of all the assembly of Israel, and he spread forth his hands.

Solomon made a brazen altar, the length of which was five cubits, and the width five cubits, and the height three cubits; and he set it in the midst of the court, and he stood upon it, and he knelt down upon his knees before all the assembly of Israel, and he spread forth his hands toward heaven.
And he said, "O Lord God of Israel, there is no God like Thee in heaven above or on earth beneath, who keepest covenant and mercy with Thy servants that walk before Thee with all their heart."
"Thou hast kept with Thy servant David my father that which Thou hast promised him; Thou spakest with Thy mouth, and hast fulfilled it with Thine hand, as it is this day."

Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, keep with Thy servant David my father that which Thou hast promised him, saying, 'There shall not fail thee a man in My sight to sit on the throne of Israel; so that Thy children take heed to their way, that they walk before Me as thou hast walked before Me.'
Now therefore, O Lord God of Israel, let Thy word be verified, which Thou hast spoken unto Thy servant David.
"But will God indeed dwell on the earth? Behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain Thee; how much less this house that I have built?"
Nevertheless, O Lord my God, regard the prayer and the supplication of Thy servant, to hearken unto the cry and to the prayer which Thy servant prayeth before Thee this day.

That Thine eyes may be open toward this house night and day, even toward the place of which Thou hast said, 'My name shall be there;' that Thou mayest hearken unto the prayer which Thy servant shall make toward this place.
And hearken Thou to the supplication of Thy servant, and of Thy people Israel, when they shall pray toward this place; and hear Thou in heaven Thy dwelling place; and when Thou hearest, forgive.
"If a man shall sin against his neighbor, and he shall swear an oath before thine altar in this house, and he shall come and swear before thee,"

"Hear thou in heaven; and do, and be a judge over thy servants; and against the wicked bring judgment; and answer them according to their way; and cleanse the innocent; as the righteous shall be rewarded."

"When thy people Israel shall be defeated before the enemy because they have sinned against thee, and they shall return to thee and confess thy name, and pray and make supplication before thee in this house,"
"Hear thou in heaven; and forgive the sin of thy people Israel, and restore them to the land which thou didst give to their fathers."
"When the heavens are shut up and there is no rain because they have sinned against thee; if they pray toward this place and confess thy name, and turn from their sin when thou dost afflict them,"

"Hear thou in heaven; and forgive the sin of thy servants and of thy people Israel, and show them the good way wherein they should walk; and send rain upon thy land which thou hast given to thy people for an inheritance."

"If there be famine in the land, or pestilence, or blasting, or mildew, or locust, or caterpillar; if their enemies besiege them in the cities of their land; whatsoever plague or whatsoever sickness there be;"
"If there be any man or if thy people Israel be afflicted with any plague or sickness, and they shall spread forth their hands toward this house,"
"Hear thou in heaven thy dwelling place; and forgive, and render unto every man according to all his ways, whose heart thou knowest; for thou only knowest the hearts of all the children of men."
"That all the people of the earth may know thy name, to fear thee, as do thy people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by thy name."

"For the foreigner who is not of Your people Israel, when he comes from a distant land for the sake of Your great name, and for Your mighty hand, and for Your outstretched arm, when he comes and prays toward this house in the time of his supplication,

You hear in heaven, Your dwelling place; and all the earth's peoples shall know Your name, that they may fear You, as does Your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by Your name.
"When Your people go out to battle against their enemies, wherever You send them, and when they pray to You toward this city which You have chosen and the house which I have built for Your name,
hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, Your dwelling place; and maintain their cause.
"For there is no man who does not sin, and if You become angry with them and deliver them to their enemies, and they are taken captive to a land far or near,

yet when they come to themselves in the land where they were carried captive, and repent and make supplication to You in the land of their captors, saying, 'We have sinned and done wrong, we have acted wickedly,'

and when they return to You with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captors, where they were taken captive, and pray toward their land which You gave to their fathers, the city which You have chosen, and the house which I have built for Your name,
then hear their prayer and their supplication in heaven, Your dwelling place; and maintain their cause, and forgive Your people who have sinned against You.
"Now, O my God, let Your eyes be open and Your ears attentive to the prayer that is made in this place.
Now, O Lord God, arise to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your might; let Your priests, O Lord God, be clothed with salvation, and let Your saints rejoice in goodness."
O Lord God, do not turn away Your face from the one who has received from You; but think upon Your servant David with mercy.

sections.title: To honor the house of the Lord is a sacred duty.

verses.text: And Solomon, when he had made this prayer, fire came down from heaven and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of the Lord filled the house.
For the glory of the Lord had filled the house of the Lord, so that the priests could not enter into the house of the Lord on that day.

And all the children of Israel, when the fire descended, saw the glory of the Lord upon the house; and they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground upon the pavement, and worshipped, and praised the Lord, saying, "For He is good; for His mercy endureth forever."
And the king, Solomon, and all the people of Israel offered sacrifices before the Lord.
On that day, the king Solomon offered twenty-two thousand oxen and one hundred twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of the Lord.

And the priests stood in their place, and the Levites also, with the instruments of David, which David made to praise the Lord, saying, "For His mercy endureth forever," when David praised by their ministry; and the priests sounded trumpets before them, and all Israel stood.

And Solomon had made a dedication in the midst of the court that was before the house of the Lord; for there he offered burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings, because the brazen altar which was before the Lord was too little to receive the burnt offerings and the meat offerings and the fat.

And Solomon, and all the congregation of Israel that were assembled unto him, from the entering in of Hamath unto the river of Egypt, were there before the Lord, in that time they kept the feast seven days.
And the feast was in the seventh month; and he kept the feast seven days, and on the eighth day was a solemn assembly; for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.

In the eighth month, on the twenty-third day of the month, he sent the people away to their tents, glad and merry in heart for the goodness that the Lord had shown unto David, and to Solomon, and to Israel His people.
ሰሎሞንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የንጉሡን ቤት፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤትና በራሱ ቤት ይሠራው ዘንድ በልቡ ያሰበውን ሁሉ ጨረሰ፤ አከናወነም።
እግዚአብሔርም ለሰሎሞን በሌሊት ተገልጦ እንዲህ አለው፥ “ ጸሎትህን ሰምቻለሁ፤ ይህንም ስፍራ ለራሴ ለመሥዋዕት ቤት መርጫለሁ።
ዝናብ እንዳይወርድ ሰማያቱን ብዘጋ፥ ወይም የሚያፈራውን እንጨት ሁሉ ይበላ ዘንድ አንበጣን ባዝዘው፥ ወይም በሕዝቤ ላይ ቸነፈር ብሰድድ፥
በስሜ የተጠሩት ሕዝቤ ሰውነታቸውን አዋርደው ቢጸልዩ፥ ፊቴንም ቢፈልጉ፥ ከክፉ መንገዳቸውም ቢመለሱ፥ በሰማይ ሆኜ እሰማለሁ፥ ኀጢአታቸውንም ይቅር እላለሁ፤ ምድራቸውንም እፈውሳለሁ።
አሁንም በዚህ ስፍራ ለሚጸለይ ጸሎት ዐይኖች ይገለጣሉ፤ ጆሮዎችም ያዳምጣሉ።
አሁንም ስሜ ለዘለዓለም በዚያ ይኖር ዘንድ ይህን ቤት መርጫለሁ፤ ቀድሻለሁም፤ ዐይኖችና ልቤም ዘወትር በዚያ ይሆናሉ።
አንተም ደግሞ አባትህ ዳዊት እንደ ሄደ በፊቴ ብትሄድ፥ እንዳዘዝሁም ሁሉ ብታደርግ፥ ሥርዐቴንና ፍርዴንም ብትጠብቅ፥
ከአባትህ ከዳዊት ጋር፦ ‘በእስራኤል ላይ አለቃ የሚሆን ከዘርህ አይታጣም’ ብዬ ቃል ኪዳን እንዳደረግሁ የመንግሥትህን ዙፋን አጸናለሁ።
“እናንተ ግን ብትመለሱ፥ የሰጠኋችሁን ሥርዐቴንና ትእዛዜን ብትተዉ፥ ሄዳችሁም ሌሎችን አማልክት ብታመልኩ፥ ብትሰግዱላቸውም፥
እኔም ለአባቶቻችሁ ከሰጠኋቸው ምድር እነቅላችኋለሁ፤ ለስሜም የቀደስሁትን ይህን ቤት ከፊቴ እጥለዋለሁ፤ በአሕዛብም ሁሉ መካከል ምሳሌና ተረት አደርገዋለሁ።
And it shall come to pass, when one shall pass by this house, and shall see it, he shall say, “Why hath the Lord done thus unto this land and to this house?” and he shall be astonished.

And they shall answer and say, “Because they forsook the Lord their God, who brought forth their fathers out of the land of Egypt, and have taken hold of other gods, and have worshipped them, and served them; therefore hath this evil come upon them.”
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ሰሎሞን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤትና የራሱን ቤት የሠራበት ሃያ ዓመት በተፈጸመ ጊዜ፥
ኪራም ለሰሎሞን የሰጠውን ከተሞች ሰሎሞን ሠራቸው፤ የእስራኤልንም ልጆች አኖረባቸው።
ሰሎሞንም ወደ ኤማትሱባ ሄደ፤ በረታባትም።
በምድረ በዳም ያለውን ተድሞርን፥ በኤማትም የጸኑ ከተሞችን ሁሉ ሠራ።
ደግሞም ቅጥርና መዝጊያ፥ መወርወሪያም የነበራቸውን የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ላይኛውን ቤትሖርን፥ ታችኛውንም ቤትሖርን ሠራ።
ባዕላትንም፥ ለሰሎሞንም የነበሩትን የዕቃ ቤት ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የሰረገላውንም ከተሞች ሁሉ፥ የፈረሰኞችንም ከተሞች፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም፥ በሊባኖስም፥ በመንግሥቱም ምድር ሁሉ ሰሎሞን ይሠራ ዘንድ የወደደውን ሁሉ ሠራ።
ከኬጤዎናውያን፥ ከአሞሬዎናውያን፥ ከፌርዜዎናውያንም፥ ከኤዎናውያንም፥ ከኢያቡሴዎናውያንም የቀሩትን፥ ከእስራኤል ወገን ያልሆኑትን ሕዝብ ሁሉ፥
የእስራኤልም ልጆች ያላጠፉአቸውን፥ በኋላቸውም በምድር ላይ የቀሩትን ልጆቻቸውን ሰሎሞን እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ገባሮች አደረጋቸው።
ሰሎሞንም በመንግሥቱ ከእስራኤል ልጆች ማንንም አገልጋይ አላደረገም፤ እነርሱ ሰልፈኞች፥ የሹሞችም አለቆች፥ የሰረገሎችና የፈረሰኞች ባልደራሶች ነበሩና።
እነዚህም በሕዝቡ ላይ ያለውን ሥራ የሚቈጣጠሩ የንጉሡ የሰሎሞን ዓይነተኞች አለቆች ሁለት መቶ አምሳ ነበሩ።

And Solomon said, "The place where the Ark of the Lord entered is holy, and my wife shall not dwell in the house of David, king of Israel." Thus he sent the daughter of Pharaoh from the city of David to the house of Saralath.
And at that time, Solomon offered to the Lord in the house of the Lord, before the altar, the sacrifices that are to be offered to the Lord.

And Moses commanded, as their custom was, that every day, on their Sabbaths, at their appointed times, and at their feasts, three times a year, at the feast of unleavened bread, and at the feast of weeks, and at the feast of tabernacles, they should offer sacrifices.

And the man of God, David, was thus adorned, and the priests, according to the order of their service, were to serve each week as they were appointed; and the Levites were to give thanks according to their order, and to serve before the priests each week as they were appointed; and the singers also, in every gate, were to serve each week as they were appointed.
And concerning all that the king commanded regarding the priests and the Levites, nothing was left undone.
Behold, from the time the foundation was laid, Solomon prepared all the work of the house of the Lord until it was completed. And the house of the Lord was completed.
And Solomon went at that time to the land of Edom, to the shore of the sea, to Gezeron and to Elath.

And Hiram sent him ships and skilled sailors who knew the sea, by the hand of his servants; and they went with the servants of Solomon to Ophir, and took from there four hundred and fifty talents of gold, and brought it to King Solomon.

sections.title: The journey of King Solomon to Jerusalem.

verses.text: And the Queen of Sheba, when she heard of the fame of Solomon, came to test him with hard questions. And she came to Jerusalem with a very great retinue, with camels bearing spices and very much gold, and precious stones. And when she came to Solomon, she told him all that was on her mind.
And Solomon answered all her questions; there was nothing hidden from Solomon that he could not explain to her.
And the Queen of Sheba saw the wisdom of Solomon, and the house that he had built;

The food of his table, the seating of his officials, and the attendance of his servants, and their clothing, and his cupbearers, and their clothing, and his burnt offerings that he offered at the house of the Lord; she was overwhelmed.
And she said to the king, “The report was true that I heard in my own land of your words and of your wisdom.
But I did not believe the reports until I came and my own eyes had seen it; and behold, the half was not told me. Your wisdom and prosperity surpass the report that I heard.
These men are your servants; they stand continually before you and hear your wisdom; these your servants are blessed.

Blessed be the Lord your God, who has delighted in you and set you on the throne of Israel! Because the Lord loved Israel forever, he has made you king, that you may execute justice and righteousness.

And she gave the king a hundred and twenty talents of gold, and a very great quantity of spices, and precious stones. Never again did such a quantity of spices come in as that which the Queen of Sheba gave to King Solomon.
The servants of Huram and the servants of Solomon brought gold from Ophir, and they brought from Ophir a great amount of almug wood and precious stones.
And the king made a throne of ivory for himself, and overlaid it with the finest gold, and he made a great seat for the singers, and thus it was that there was none like it in all the land of Judah.
And she gave to King Solomon more than all that she had brought to him; for King Solomon had received all that she desired, and she returned to her own land with her servants.

sections.title: The wealth of King Solomon was abundant.

verses.text: And every year, there came to Solomon a weight of gold, six hundred threescore and six talents of gold.
The merchants and traders from all the kings of the Arab lands, and the governors of the region, brought gold and silver to King Solomon.
And the king Solomon made two hundred shields of beaten gold; six hundred shekels of gold went to one shield.
He also made three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield. And the king placed them in the house of the forest of Lebanon.
The king also made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with the best gold.
And there were six steps leading up to the throne, and the throne had a footstool of gold; and on either side of the seat were two lions standing.
And twelve lions stood there on the six steps, one on either side; there was not the like made in any kingdom.

And all the vessels of King Solomon were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Lebanon were of pure gold; none were of silver; it was not counted as anything in the days of Solomon.
And the ships that brought gold from Tarshish, with the servants of Huram, every three years once came bringing gold, silver, ivory, and apes and baboons.
And King Solomon surpassed all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
And all the kings of the earth sought to hear the wisdom which God had put in the heart of Solomon.
And each of them brought in their season gifts of silver and gold, garments and armor, spices, horses and mules, and they brought them year by year.
And Solomon had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen; and they dwelt in the cities for chariots, and with the king at Jerusalem.
From the river of Egypt unto the great river, the river Euphrates, all the kings that were on this side of the river were subdued.
And the king made silver and gold in Jerusalem as plenteous as stones, and cedar trees made he as the sycamore trees that are in the vale for abundance.
And horses brought he out of Egypt and out of all lands.

And the rest of the acts of Solomon, first and last, are they not written in the book of Nathan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer against Jeroboam the son of Nebat?
And Solomon reigned in Jerusalem over all Israel forty years.
And Solomon slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David his father; and Rehoboam his son reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The ten plagues came upon Israel as in the days of old.

verses.text: And all Israel gathered together unto Shechem; and Jeroboam went to Shechem.
For Jeroboam the son of Nebat had fled from the presence of King Solomon, and had been dwelling in Egypt; and when he heard it, he returned out of Egypt.
And they sent and called him; and Jeroboam and all Israel came and spake unto Rehoboam, saying,
“Thy father made our yoke grievous; now therefore lighten thou the grievous servitude of thy father, and his heavy yoke that he put upon us, and we will serve thee.”
And he said unto them, “Depart yet for three days, then come again to me.” And the people departed.
And King Rehoboam said, “What counsel give ye that I may answer this people?” And he gathered together the young men that were grown up with him, and which stood before him.
And they spake unto him, saying, “If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.”
But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him.
And he said unto them, “What counsel give ye that we may answer this people, who have spoken to me, saying, ‘Lighten the yoke that thy father did put upon us’?”

And the young men that were grown up with him spake unto him, saying, “Thus shalt thou speak unto this people that spake unto thee, saying, ‘Thy father made our yoke heavy, but thou make it lighter unto us.’”
"Now my father was harsh upon you; but I will add to your yoke; my father chastised you with whips; but I will chastise you with scorpions," thus they spoke.
And the king said, "Return unto me on the third day," and as he had spoken, Jeroboam and all the people came to Rehoboam on the third day.
And the king gave a strong answer unto them; and the king Rehoboam forsook the counsel of the elders.
"My father made your yoke heavy; but I will add to it; my father chastised you with whips; but I will chastise you with scorpions," thus he spoke as the young men advised him.
And the Lord, by the word of Ahijah the Shilonite, concerning Jeroboam the son of Nebat, had spoken that it should be fulfilled; therefore the king hearkened not unto the people.

And the king, because the people hearkened not unto him, said, "What portion have we in David? and what inheritance in the son of Jesse? Israel, to your tents! Now see to thine own house, David," thus they answered the king. And all Israel went to their tents.
But the men of Israel who dwelt in the cities of Judah, they spoke unto Rehoboam.
And king Rehoboam sent Adoram, who was over the tribute, and all Israel stoned him with stones; and king Rehoboam made speed to get him up to his chariot and fled to Jerusalem.
And Israel hath been in rebellion against the house of David unto this day.

sections.title: The word of prophecy from heaven.

verses.text: And when Rehoboam came to Jerusalem, he gathered the house of Judah and the house of Benjamin, a hundred and eighty thousand chosen men, warriors, to fight against Israel, that he might bring the kingdom again to Rehoboam.
And the word of the Lord came unto him, saying,
"To Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, king of Judah, and to all Israel in Judah and Benjamin, thus saith the Lord:

'Thus saith the Lord: Ye shall not go up, nor fight against your brethren the children of Israel; return every man to his house; for this thing is done of me.' And they hearkened to the word of the Lord, and returned to depart, according to the word of the Lord."
So Rehoboam dwelt in Jerusalem, and built cities for defense in Judah.
And he built even Bethlehem, and Etam, and Tekoa;
And Bethzur, and Succoth, and Adullam;
And Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph;
And Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah;
And Sochoh, and Eilon, and Hebron, which are in Judah.
And he appointed the officers; and he gathered the rulers; and he provided for them the food, the oil, and the wine.
In all the cities, he did not leave a single altar unturned, and he greatly fortified the cities; and Judah and Benjamin were of his lineage.
And all the priests and Levites who were in Israel came to him from all their territories.
For the priests of the Lord were not to be, and Jeroboam and his sons had cast them away, and the Levites forsook their stations and came to Judah and to Jerusalem.
But he made for the high places worthless idols, and Jeroboam appointed priests for the high places.
Moreover, to seek the God of their fathers, the Lord God of Israel, all whose hearts were inclined to seek the Lord God of Israel followed them and came to Jerusalem.
For three years, they walked in the way of David and Solomon, and for three years, the kingdom of Judah was strengthened; and they established Rehoboam, the son of Solomon.
And Rehoboam took for himself a wife, the daughter of Abijah, the daughter of Jerimoth, and her mother was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom.
And she bore him sons, Jeush, Shemariah, and Zaham.
And after her, he took Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom, and she bore him Abijah, Attai, Ziza, and Shelomith.

And Rehoboam took for himself Maacah the daughter of Absalom, more than all his wives and concubines; and he had eighteen wives and sixty concubines; and he begat twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.
And Rehoboam acted wisely, for he made Abijah the son of Maacah chief over his brethren, to be ruler.

And he was a wise man; and he took all his children from the land of Judah and from the land of Benjamin, from all the fortified cities; and he provided them with abundant food; and he sought many wives for them.

sections.title: And the king of Egypt, Shishak, came up against Jerusalem as he had invaded.

verses.text: እንዲህም ሆነ፤ የሮብዓም መንግሥት በጸናች ጊዜ፥ እርሱም በበረታ ጊዜ፥ የእግዚአብሔርን ሕግ ረሳ፤ እስራኤልም ሁሉ ከእርሱ ጋር ረሱ።
ሮብዓም በነገሠ በአምስተኛው ዓመት የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሱስቀም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ። እግዚአብሔርን በድለዋልና፤
ሺህ ሁለት መቶ ሰረገሎችንና ስድሳ ሺህ ፈረሰኞችን ይዞ መጣ፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ከግብፅ ለመጣው ሕዝብ ቍጥር አልነበረውም፤ እነርሱም የልብያ ሰዎች፥ ሞጠግሊያናውያን፥ የኢትዮጵያም ሰዎች ነበሩ።
በይሁዳም የነበሩትን ምሽጎች ከተሞች ያዙ። እስከ ኢየሩሳሌምም ደረሱ።
ነቢዩም ሰማያ ወደ ሮብዓምና ከሱስቀም ሸሽተው በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ተሰበሰቡት ወደ ይሁዳ መሳፍንት መጥቶ እንዲህ አላቸው፥ “እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፦ እናንተ ተዋችሁኝ፤ ስለዚህ እኔ ደግሞ በግብፅ ንጉሥ በሱስቀም እጅ ተውኋችሁ።”
የእስራኤልም መሳፍንትና ንጉሡ አፈሩ፥ “እግዚአብሔር ጻድቅ ነው” አሉ።
እግዚአብሔርም እንደ ተመለሱና እንደ ተፀፀቱ ባየ ጊዜ የእግዚአብሔር ቃል፥ “ከተመለሱ አላጠፋቸውም፤ ከጥቂት ቀንም በኋላ አድናቸዋለሁ፤ ቍጣዬም በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አይፈስስም” ሲል ወደ ሰማያ መጣ።
ለእኔ መገዛትንና ለምድር ነገሥታት መገዛትን ያውቃሉና አገልጋዮች ይሆናሉ።
የግብፅ ንጉሥ ሱስቀምም ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጣ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤተ መዛግብትና የንጉሡን ቤተ መዛግብት ወሰደ፤ ሁሉንም ወሰደ፤ ደግሞም ሰሎሞን የሠራቸውን የወርቁን አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻዎችን ወሰደ።
ንጉሡም ሮብዓም በእነርሱ ፋንታ የናስ አላባሽ አግሬ ጋሻዎችን ሠራ፤ ሮብዓምም የንጉሡን ቤት ደጅ በሚጠብቁ በዘበኞች አለቃ እጅ አኖራቸው።
And the king entered into the house of the Lord; the number of those who were slain had come upon him, and he returned to dwell within the house of the slain.
In the time of his affliction, the wrath of the Lord was far from him; yet He did not utterly destroy him, for in Judah there was found a good thing.

And King Rehoboam strengthened himself in Jerusalem; and he became king. And Rehoboam reigned for forty-one years; and the Lord established his name among all the cities of Israel, for he ruled in Jerusalem for seventeen years; and his mother was a woman of Ammon, named Naamah.
And he did not turn his heart to seek the Lord, but he did evil in the sight of the Lord.

Behold, concerning Rehoboam, the first and the last things, are they not written in the book of the prophet Shemaiah and in the visions of the seer? And Rehoboam contended with Jeroboam all the days of his life.
And Rehoboam rested with his fathers, and was buried in the city of David; and his son Abijah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The war that Abijah, the king of Judah, waged against Jeroboam.

verses.text: And Jeroboam became king over Israel in the eighteenth year of Abijah, reigning over Judah.
And he reigned three years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Maacah, the daughter of Abishalom. And there was war between Abijah and Jeroboam.
Abijah gathered together four hundred thousand mighty men of valor to go to battle; and Jeroboam gathered eight hundred thousand valiant men of strength against him.
Abijah stood upon Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Ephraim, and said, "Hear me, Jeroboam and all Israel;
"Will you not know that the Lord God of Israel gave the kingdom over Israel to David and to his sons by a covenant of salt forever?"
But Jeroboam, the son of Nebat, the servant of Solomon, rose up and rebelled against his lord.
And worthless men gathered to him, and they strengthened themselves against Rehoboam, the son of Solomon, when Rehoboam was young and tender-hearted and could not withstand them.
Now therefore, you speak to Rehoboam, the son of David, saying, "You are a great people, and Jeroboam has made you golden calves to worship."

"Have you not cast out the priests of the Lord, the sons of Aaron, and the Levites, and made for yourselves priests like the peoples of other lands? Whoever comes to consecrate himself with a young bull and seven rams, the same may become a priest of things that are not gods."
"But we will not forsake the Lord our God, nor will we forsake the priests who are the sons of Aaron and the Levites, who minister to the Lord our God."

In every morning and in every evening, they shall prepare for the Lord their offerings and their sweet incense; and the showbread shall be set upon the pure table, and the golden lampstands shall be arranged to give light in the evening. And we shall keep the commandments of our God, the Lord; but you shall be cast down.
Behold, the Lord is our leader; the priests who blow the trumpets are with us; they shall cry unto you. O children of Israel, do not be afraid, for your God, the Lord, is with you.
But Jeroboam caused a mighty army to come upon them; and they were before Judah, and the mighty army came upon them from behind.
And the men of Judah turned back to see, and behold, the battle was before them and behind them; and they cried unto the Lord, and the priests blew the trumpets.
And the men of Judah cried out; and when the men of Judah cried out, the Lord struck Jeroboam and all Israel before Abijah and his people.
And the children of Israel fled before the men of Judah; and the Lord delivered them into their hand.
And Abijah and his people struck them with a great slaughter; and five hundred thousand chosen men of Israel fell slain.
At that time, the children of Israel were subdued; for the children of Judah relied on the Lord God of their fathers and prevailed.
Abijah followed Jeroboam and struck them; and he took the cities of Bethel and its villages, and Jeshanah and its villages, and Ephron and its villages.
And Jeroboam did not recover strength again in the days of Abijah; and the Lord struck him, and he died.
Abraham was blessed; he took for himself four wives; and he begot twenty-two male children and sixteen female children.
The matters concerning Abraham and the words spoken concerning him are written in the book of the prophet Ado.
Abraham was gathered to his fathers; and he was buried in the city of David; and his son Asa reigned in his stead. In his time, the land had rest for ten years.
Asa did that which was good and right in the sight of the Lord his God.
He removed the altars of the strange gods, and the high places, and broke down the images, and cut down the groves.
And he commanded Judah to seek the Lord God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
He took away the altars of the strange gods and the images out of all the cities of Judah; and the kingdom was quiet before him.
And he built fenced cities in Judah; for the land had rest, and he had no war in those years, because the Lord had given him rest.

And he said unto Judah, “Let us build these cities, and make about them walls and towers, gates and bars, while the land is yet before us; for we have sought the Lord our God, and he hath given us rest on every side.” So they built and prospered.

And for the army of Asa, there were three hundred thousand men that bare shields and spears, of Judah; and two hundred eighty thousand men of Benjamin that bare shields and drew bows; all these were mighty men of valor.
And the king of Ethiopia came against them with an host of a million men and three hundred chariots; and came unto Mareshah.
Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.

And he cried out to his God, saying, “O Lord, whether in abundance or in scarcity, Thou art not unmindful of our salvation; O Lord, our God, in Thee do we put our trust, and in Thy name we have come unto this great multitude; help us; O Lord, our God, Thou art He; let not man prevail against Thee.”
And the Lord smote the Ethiopians before Asa and before Judah; and the Ethiopians fled.

Asa, and the people that were with him, pursued them even unto Gerar; and the Ethiopians were overthrown, so that they could not recover themselves; for they were destroyed before the Lord and before His host; and they carried away very much spoil.
And they smote all the cities round about Gerar, for the fear of the Lord came upon them; and they spoiled all the cities, for there was exceeding much spoil in them.
And they smote also the tents of the cattle, and carried away very much sheep and camels; and they returned to Jerusalem.
And the Spirit of the Lord came upon Adad, the son of Azariah.

And he stood before the king, and all the people of Judah and Benjamin gathered unto him; and he said, "Hear me, O Asa, and all Judah and Benjamin: If ye be with the Lord, He will be with you; and if ye seek Him, He will be found of you; but if ye forsake Him, He will forsake you."
And Israel, for a long time, did not seek the true God, and they were without a teacher, and without law.
In their distress, they shall turn to the God of Israel and seek the Lord; and He will be found of them.
In those days, there shall be no peace for him that goeth out nor for him that cometh in; but great shall be the wrath of the Lord upon all nations.
For the Lord shall trouble them in all their distress, and nation shall be against nation, and city against city.
But for you, He shall be a strength in your work, and your hands shall not be weak."

And when Asa heard these words and the prophecy of Azariah the son of Oded, he took courage; and he removed the abominations out of all the land of Judah and Benjamin, and out of the cities which he had taken from the mount of Ephraim, and renewed the altar of the Lord that was before the porch of the Lord.

And the Lord his God was with him; and when he saw that many people of Israel had gathered unto him, he gathered Judah and Benjamin, and all the men of Ephraim and Manasseh, and those of Simeon who had joined themselves with them.
And they were gathered at Jerusalem in the third month of the fifteenth year of the reign of Asa.
And on that day, they brought seven hundred oxen and seven thousand sheep as a sacrifice to the Lord.
With their perfect hearts and perfect souls, they called upon the God of their fathers, the Lord, and made a covenant.
He who does not seek the God of Israel, whether small or great, whether man or woman, shall be put to death.
And for the Lord, with a loud voice and with joy, with gladness and with the brightness of the sun, they made a proclamation.
For their hearts are perfect, and their minds seek Him; and He has been found by them, and all Judah rejoiced in Him; and the Lord gave them rest all around.
And the king cast out his mother Maakah from being queen because she had made an idol in a grove; and Asa cut down her idol and stamped it to dust, and burned it by the brook Kidron.
But the records that were on the high places were not removed from Israel; nevertheless, they remained in Israel until this day; yet the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
And his father David had consecrated the holy things, and he brought in the silver and the gold, and the special vessels into the house of the Lord.
And in the time of Asa, there was no war until the thirty-fifth year of his reign.

sections.title: Judah and Israel are as one.

verses.text: አሳ በነገሠ በሠላሳ ስድስተኛው ዓመት የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ባኦስ በይሁዳ ላይ ዘመተ፥ ወደ ይሁዳም ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ ማንም መውጣትና መግባት እንዳይችል ራማን ሠራት።
አሳም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤትና ከንጉሥ ቤት መዝገብ ብርና ወርቅ ወስዶ፦ በደማስቆ ወደ ተቀመጠው ወደ ሶርያ ንጉሥ ወደ ወልደ አዴር ላከ። እንዲህም አለው፦
“በአባቴና በአባትህ መካከል እንደ ነበረው ቃል ኪዳን በእኔና በአንተ መካከል አድርግ፤ የእስራኤል ንጉሥ ባኦስ ከእኔ ዘንድ እንዲርቅ መጥተህ ትወጋው ዘንድ እነሆ፥ ወርቅና ብር ልኬልሃለሁ።”
ወልደ አዴርም ንጉሡን አሳን ሰማው፤ የሠራዊቱንም አለቆች በእስራኤል ከተሞች ላይ ሰደደ፤ እነርሱም አእዮንንና ዳንን፥ አቤልማይምንና የንፍታሌምንም አውራጃ ከተሞች ሁሉ መቱ።
ባኦስም በሰማ ጊዜ ራማን መሥራት ተወ፤ ሥራውንም አቋረጠ።
የይሁዳ ንጉሥ አሳም የይሁዳን ሰዎች ሁሉ ሰበሰበ፤ ባኦስ ይሠራበት የነበረውን የራማን ድንጋይና እንጨት ወሰደ፤ እርሱም ገባዖንንና መሴፋን ሠራበት።
በዚያን ጊዜም ነቢዩ አናኒ ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ አሳ መጥቶ እንዲህ አለው፥ “በሶርያ ንጉሥ ታምነሃልና፥ በአምላክህም በእግዚአብሔር አልታመንህምና ስለዚህ የሶርያ ንጉሥ ጭፍራ ከእጆችህ አምልጠዋል።
ኢትዮጵያውያንና የልብያ ሰዎች እጅግ ብዙ ሰረገሎችና ፈረሰኞች የነበሩአቸው እጅግ ታላቅ ጭፍራ አልነበሩምን? በእግዚአብሔር ስለ ታመንህ በእጅህ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው።
እግዚአብሔር ልቡ በእርሱ ዘንድ ፍጹም የሆነውን ያጸና ዘንድ ዐይኖቹ በምድር ሁሉ ይመለከታሉና። አሁንም ባለማወቅህ በድለሃል፤ ስለዚህም ከዛሬ ጀምሮ ጦርነት ይሆንብሃል።”
አሳም በነቢዩ በአናኒ ላይ ተቈጣ፤ ስለዚህም ነገር ተቈጥቶአልና በግዞት አኖረው፤ በዚያን ጊዜም አሳ ከሕዝቡ አያሌ ሰዎችን አስጨነቀ።
The account of the first and the last, behold, it is written in the book of the history of the kings of Judah and Israel.
Asa, in the thirty-fifth year of his reign, became diseased in his feet; yet his disease was severe, but in his sickness he sought not the Lord, but the physicians.
Asa slept with his fathers, and was buried with them in the city of David; and Jehoshaphat, his son, reigned in his stead in the fourth year of Asa's reign.

And they buried him in his own sepulcher, which he had made for himself in the city of David; and they laid him in a bed which was filled with sweet odours and diverse kinds of spices prepared by the apothecaries' art; and they made a very great burning for him.

sections.title: The reign of King Jehoshaphat of Judah.

verses.text: ከአሳም በኋላ ልጁ ኢዮሳፍጥ ነገሠ፤ ኢዮሳፍጥም በእስራኤል ላይ ጠነከረ።
በተመሸጉትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ ሠራዊቱን አኖረ፤ በይሁዳም ሀገር፥ አባቱም አሳ በወሰዳቸው በኤፍሬም ከተሞች መሳፍንቱን አስቀመጠ።
እግዚአብሔርም ከኢዮሳፍጥ ጋር ነበረ፤ በፊተኛዪቱም በአባቱ በዳዊት መንገድ ሄዶአልና፥ ጣዖትንም አልፈለገምና፤
ነገር ግን የአባቱን አምላክ ፈለገ፤ በአባቱም ትእዛዝ ሄደ፤ በእስራኤልም ሥራ አይደለም።
እግዚአብሔርም መንግሥቱን በእጁ አጸና፤ ይሁዳም ሁሉ እጅ መንሻ ለኢዮሳፍጥ አመጣ፤ እጅግም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ሆነለት።
ልቡም በእግዚአብሔር መንገድ ከፍ ከፍ አለ፤ የኮረብታውን መስገጃዎችና የማምለኪያ አፀዱንም ከይሁዳ አስወገደ።
በነገሠም በሦስተኛው ዓመት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ያስተምሩ ዘንድ መሳፍንቱንና ኀያላኑን ሰዎች አብድያስን፥ ዘካርያስን፥ ናትናኤልን፥ ሚኪያስን ላከ።
ከእነርሱም ጋር ሌዋውያንን ሸማያን፥ ነታንያን፥ ዛባድያን፥ አሣሄልን፥ ሰሚራሞትን፥ ዮናታንን፥ አዶንያስን፥ ጦብያን፥ ጦባዶንያስን ከእነርሱም ጋር ካህናቱን ኤሊሳማንና ኢዮራምን ላከ።
እነርሱም የእግዚአብሔርን የሕጉን መጽሐፍ ይዘው በይሁዳ ያስተምሩ ነበር፤ ወደ ይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ተመላልሰው ሕዝቡን አስተማሩ።
በይሁዳም ዙሪያ በነበሩ የምድር መንግሥታት ሁሉ ላይ ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ድንጋጤ ሆነ፤ ከኢዮሳፍጥም ጋር አልተዋጉም።

And the Philistines brought to Jehoshaphat a tribute of silver and a hand of service; and the Arabians also brought him seven thousand and seven hundred rams and seven thousand and seven hundred he-goats.
And Jehoshaphat grew strong and was exceedingly honored; and he built in Judah fortified cities and cities that were garrisoned.
And he did much work in the cities of Judah; and in Jerusalem were mighty men of valor.
Their number was as the house of their fathers; the chief of the Levites was Adnah, and with him were three hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
After him was Jehohanan, and with him were two hundred eighty thousand men.
After him was a son of Zachariah, who served God, and with him were two hundred thousand mighty men of valor.
And from Benjamin was a mighty man of valor, named Eliada; and with him were armed men bearing bows, two hundred thousand.
After him was Jehozabad, and with him were prepared for the battle one hundred eighty thousand men.
The king was served by all the cities of Judah that were fortified, and besides these, they served the king.

sections.title: The prophet Micah prophesied against Ahab, as it was spoken.

verses.text: ለኢዮሣፍጥም ብዙ ብልጥግናና ክብር ነበረው፤ ከአክዓብም ወገን ሚስት አገባ።
ከጥቂት ዓመታት በኋላም ወደ አክዓብ ወደ ሰማርያ ወረደ። አክዓብም ለእርሱና ከእርሱ ጋር ለነበሩት ሕዝብ ብዙ በጎችንና በሬዎችን አረደ፤ ወደደውም፤ ከእርሱም ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይሄድ ዘንድ አባበለው።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አክዓብ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን፥ “ከእኔ ጋር ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ትሄዳለህን?” አለው። እርሱም፥ “እኔ እንደ አንተ ነኝ፤ ሕዝቤም ለሰልፍ እንደ ሕዝብህ ናቸው፤” ብሎ መለሰለት።
ኢዮሣፍጥም የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ፥ “ዛሬ እግዚአብሔርን ጠይቅ” አለው።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ከነቢያቱ አራት መቶ ሰዎችን ሰብስቦ፥ “ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር?” አላቸው። እነርሱም፥ “እግዚአብሔር በንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ውጣ” አሉት።
ኢዮሣፍጥ ግን፥ “እንጠይቀው ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ የሆነ ሌላ ሰው በዚህ አይገኝምን?” አለ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን፥ “እግዚአብሔርን የምንጠይቅበት አንድ ሰው አለ፤ ነገር ግን ሁልጊዜ ክፉ እንጂ ከቶ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝምና እጠላዋለሁ፤ እርሱም የይምላ ልጅ ሚክያስ ነው” አለው። ኢዮሣፍጥም፥ “ንጉሡ እንዲህ አይበል” አለው።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ አንድ ጃንደረባ ጠርቶ፥ “የይምላን ልጅ ሚክያስን ፈጥነህ አምጣው” አለው።
የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ልብሰ መንግሥት ለብሰው በሰማርያ በር መግቢያ አጠገብ በአደባባይ በዙፋኖቻቸው ላይ ተቀምጠው ነበር፤ ነቢያትም ሁሉ በፊታቸው ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።
የካህናን ልጅ ሴዴቅያስም የብረት ቀንዶች ሠርቶ፦ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላል፥ “ሶርያውያንን እስክታጠፋቸው ድረስ በእነዚህ ትወጋለህ” አለ።
ነቢያትም ሁሉ፥ “እግዚአብሔር በንጉሡ እጅ አሳልፎ ይሰጣታልና ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ውጣና ተከናወን” እያሉ እንዲሁ ትንቢት ይናገሩ ነበር።
ሚክያስንም ሊጠራ የሄደ መልእክተኛ፥ “እነሆ፥ ነቢያት በአንድ አፍ ሆነው ለንጉሡ መልካም ይናገራሉ፤ ቃልህም እንደ ቃላቸው እንዲሆን መልካም እንድትናገር እለምንሃለሁ” አለው።
ሚክያስም፥ “ሕያው እግዚአብሔርን! አምላኬ የሚለውን እርሱን እናገራለሁ” አለ።
ወደ ንጉሡም በመጣ ጊዜ ንጉሡ፥ “ሚክያስ ሆይ፥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ለሰልፍ ልሂድን? ወይስ ልቅር?” አለው።
ነቢዩ ሚክያስም፥ “ውጣ፤ ተከናወን፤ በእጅህም አልፈው ይሰጣሉ” አለ። ንጉሡም፥ “በእግዚአብሔር ስም ከእውነት በቀር እንዳትነግረኝ ስንት ጊዜ አምልሃለሁ?” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “እስራኤል ሁሉ ጠባቂ እንደሌላቸው በጎች በተራሮች ላይ ተበትነው አየሁ፤ እግዚአብሔርም፦ ለእነዚህ ጌታ የላቸውም፥ እያንዳንዱም በሰላም ወደ ቤቱ ይመለስ አለ” ብሎ ተናገረ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥን፥ “ክፉ እንጂ መልካም ትንቢት አይናገርልኝም አላልሁህምን?” አለው።
ሚክያስም አለ፥ “እንዲህ አይደለም፤ እንግዲህ የእግዚአብሔርን ቃል ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር በዙፋኑ ተቀምጦ፥ የሰማይ ሠራዊት ሁሉ በቀኙና በግራው፤ ቆመው አየሁ።”
እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ወጥቶ በሬማት ዘገለዓድ ይወድቅ ዘንድ የእስራኤልን ንጉሥ አክዓብን የሚያታልል ማን ነው?” አለ። አንዱም እንደዚህ፥ ሌላውም እንደዚያ ያለ ነገር ተናገረ።
መንፈስም መጣ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቆሞ፥ “እኔ አታልለዋለሁ” አለ። እግዚአብሔርም፥ “በምን ታታልለዋለህ?” አለው።
እርሱም፥ “ወጥቼ በነቢያት ሁሉ አፍ የሐሰት መንፈስ እሆናለሁ” አለ። እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ታታልለዋለህ፤ ይቀናሃል፥ ውጣ፤ እንዲህም አድርግ” አለው።
“አሁንም እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር በእነዚህ በነቢያትህ አፍ የሐሰት መንፈስን አድርጎአል፤ እግዚአብሔርም በአንተ ላይ ክፉ ተናግሮብሃል።”
የካህናንም ልጅ ሴዴቅያስ ቀረበ፤ ሚክያስንም በጥፊ መታውና፥ “የእግዚአብሔር መንፈስ ከአንተ ጋር ይናገር ዘንድ በምን መንገድ ከእኔ አለፈ?” አለው።
ሚክያስም፥ “እነሆ፥ በዚያ ቀን ልትሸሸግ ከእልፍኝ ወደ እልፍኝ ስትሄድ ታያለህ” አለ።
የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ እንዲህ አለ፥ “ሚክያስን ውሰዱ፤ ወደ ከተማዪቱም አለቃ ወደ ኤሜር፥ ወደ ንጉሡም ልጆች አለቃ ወደ ኢዮአስ መልሱት
እንዲህም በሉአቸው፦ ንጉሡ እንዲህ ይላል፦ በደኅና እስክመለስ ድረስ ይህን ሰው በግዞት አኑሩት፤ የመከራም እንጀራ መግቡት፤ የመከራም ውኃ አጠጡት።”
ሚክያስም፥ “በደኅና ብትመለስ እግዚአብሔር በእኔ አልተናገረም” አለ። “ደግሞም እናንተ ሕዝቡ ሁሉ ስሙኝ” አለ።
የእስራኤል ንጉሥና የይሁዳ ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ሬማት ዘገለዓድ ወጡ።
የእስራኤል ንጉሥም ኢዮሣፍጥን፥ “ልብሴን ለውጬ ወደ ጦርነት እገባለሁ፤ አንተ ግን የእኔን ልብስ ልበስ” አለው። የእስራኤልም ንጉሥ ልብሱን ለወጠ፤ ወደ ሰልፍም ገባ።
የሶርያም ንጉሥ ከእርሱ ጋር የነበሩትን የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች፦ ከእስራኤልም ንጉሥ በቀር ትንሽ ቢሆን ወይም ትልቅ ከማናቸውም ጋር አትጋጠሙ ብሎ አዝዞ ነበር።

And the captains of the chariots, when they saw Jehoshaphat, said, "It is the king of Israel." And they turned to fight against him; but Jehoshaphat cried out, and the Lord helped him; and God moved them to depart from him.
And the captains of the chariots, when they saw that he was not the king of Israel, turned back from pursuing him.

And a certain man drew his bow at a venture, and struck the king of Israel between the joints of the harness: therefore he said unto his chariot-man, "Turn thy hand, and carry me out of the host; for I am wounded."
And the battle increased that day; and the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the evening: and about the time of the sun going down he died.

sections.title: The prophet is indeed as Jehoshaphat, the king of Judah, has declared.

verses.text: የይሁዳም ንጉሥ ኢዮሣፍጥ ወደ ቤቱ ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም በሰላም ተመለሰ።
ነቢዩ የአናኒ ልጅ ኢዩ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፤ ንጉሡንም ኢዮሣፍጥን፥ “ኀጢአተኛውን ታግዛለህን? ወይስ እግዚአብሔር የሚጠላውን ትወድዳለህን? ስለዚህም ነገር ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ቍጣ መጥቶብሃል።
ነገር ግን የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶችን ከምድረ ይሁዳ አስወግደሃልና፥ እግዚአብሔርንም ትፈልግ ዘንድ ልብህን አዘጋጅተሃልና መልካም ነገር ተገኝቶብሃል” አለው።
ኢዮሣፍጥም በኢየሩሳሌም ተቀመጠ፤ ደግሞም ከቤርሳቤህ ጀምሮ እስከ ተራራማው እስከ ኤፍሬም ሀገር ድረስ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወጥቶ ወደ አባቶቻቸው አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር መለሳቸው።
በተመሸጉት በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ በእያንዳንዱ ከተማ ውስጥ ፈራጆችን ሾመ።
ፈራጆቹንም፥ “ለእግዚአብሔር እንጂ ለሰው አትፈርዱምና፥ የፍርድም ነገር ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና የምታደርጉትን ተመልከቱ።
አሁንም እግዚአብሔርን መፍራት በእናንተ ላይ ይሁን፤ በአምላካችንም በእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ በደልና ለሰው ፊት ማድላት፥ መማለጃም መውሰድ የለምና ሁሉን ተጠንቅቃችሁ አድርጉ” አላቸው።
ኢዮሣፍጥም ከሌዋውያንና ከካህናት፥ ከእስራኤልም የአባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች በእግዚአብሔር ፍርድ በኢየሩሳሌም በሚኖሩ ላይ ፍርድን እንዲፈርዱ በኢየሩሳሌም ሾመ።
እንዲህም ብሎ አዘዛቸው፥ “እንዲሁ እግዚአብሔርን በመፍራት፥ በቅንነትም፥ በፍጹምም ልብ አድርጉ።”
በከተሞቻቸውም ከተቀመጡት ከወንድሞቻችሁ በደምና በደም መካከል፥ በሕግና በትእዛዝ፥ በሥርዐትና በፍርድም መካከል ያለ ማናቸውም ሰው ለፍርድ ወደ እናንተ ቢመጣ እግዚአብሔርን እንዳይበድሉ፥ ቍጣም በእናንተና በወንድሞቻችሁ ላይ እንዳይመጣ አስጠንቅቁአቸው፤ እንዲህም ብታደርጉ በደለኞች አትሆኑም።

Behold, for the chief of the priests concerning all matters pertaining to the Lord is Amariah, and concerning all matters of the king, the chief of the house of Judah is Zebadiah, the son of Ishmael; he is set before you. And the book of the law and the Levites are also before you; take heed to them. May the Lord be with those who do good.
እንዲህም ሆነ፤ ከዚህ በኋላ የሞዓብና የአሞን ልጆች ከእነርሱም ጋር ምዑናውያን ኢዮሣፍጥን ሊወጉ መጡ።
ሰዎችም መጥተው፥ “ከባሕሩ ማዶ ከሶርያ ታላቅ ሠራዊት መጥቶብሃል፤ እነሆም፥ ዓይንጋዲ በተባለች በሐሴሶን ታማር ናቸው” ብለው ለኢዮሣፍጥ ነገሩት።
ኢዮሣፍጥም ፈራ፤ እግዚአብሔርንም ሊፈልግ ፊቱን አቀና፤ በይሁዳም ሁሉ ጾም አወጀ።
ይሁዳም እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ተሰበሰበ፤ ከይሁዳ ከተሞችም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልጉ ዘንድ መጡ።
ኢዮሣፍጥም በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ጉባኤ መካከል በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በአዲሱ አደባባይ ፊት ቆመ፤
እንዲህም አለ፥ “አቤቱ፥ የአባቶቻችን አምላክ ሆይ፥ በሰማይ ያለህ አምላክ አንተ አይደለህምን? የአሕዛብንስ መንግሥታት ሁሉ የምትገዛ አንተ አይደለህምን? ኀይልና ችሎታ በእጅህ ነው፤ ሊቋቋምህም የሚችል የለም።
አምላካችን ሆይ፥ በዚህ ምድር የነበሩትን አሕዛብ ከሕዝብህ ከእስራኤል ፊት ያሳደድህ፥ ለወዳጅህም ለአብርሃም ዘር ለዘለዓለም የሰጠሃት አንተ አይደለህምን?
እነርሱ ተቀመጡባት፤ ለስምህም መቅደስን ሠሩባት።
እንዲህም አሉ፦ ክፉ ነገር፥ የፍርድ ሰይፍ ወይም ቸነፈር ወይም ራብ፥ ቢመጣብን በዚህ ቤት ፊትና በፊትህ እንቆማለን፤ ስምህ በዚህ ቤት ላይ ነውና፤ በመከራችንም ወደ አንተ እንጮኻለን፥ አንተም ሰምተህ ታድነናለህ።
አሁንም እነሆ፥ እስራኤል ከግብዕ ምድር በወጡ ጊዜ ያልፉባቸው ዘንድ ያልፈቀድህላቸው የአሞንና የሞዓብ ልጆች፥ የሴይርም ተራራ ሰዎች እንዳያጠፉአቸው ከእነርሱ ፈቀቅ ብለው ነበር።
እነሆ፥ አሁን ለወሮታችን ክፋት ይመልሱልናል፤ ከሰጠኸንም ርስት ያወጡን ዘንድ መጥተዋል።
አምላካችን ሆይ፥ አንተ አትፈርድባቸውምን? ይህን የመጣብንን ታላቅ ወገን መቃወም እንችል ዘንድ ኀይል የለንም፤ የምናደርግባቸውንም አናውቅም፤ ነገር ግን ዐይኖቻችን ወደ አንተ ናቸው።”
የይሁዳም ሰዎች ሁሉ ከሚስቶቻቸው፥ ከልጆቻቸውም ጋር በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቆመው ነበር።
የእግዚአብሔርም መንፈስ ከአሳፍ ወገን በነበረው በሌዋዊው በምታንያስ ልጅ በኢያሔል ልጅ በብልአንያ ልጅ በዘካርያስ ልጅ በኡዝሔል ላይ በጉባኤው መካከል መጣ፤
እንዲህም አለ፥ “ይሁዳ ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የምትኖሩ፥ አንተም ንጉሡ ኢዮሣፍጥ! ስሙ፤ እግዚአብሔር እንዲህ ይላችኋል፦ ሰልፉ የእግዚአብሔር ነው እንጂ የእናንተ አይደለምና ከዚህ ታላቅ ወገን የተነሣ አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡም።
ነገ በእነርሱ ላይ ውረዱ፤ እነሆ፥ በአሲስ ዐቀበት ይወጣሉ፤ በሸለቆውም መጨረሻ በኢያርሔል ምድረ በዳ ፊት ለፊት ታገኙአቸዋላችሁ።
እናንተ የምቷጉ አይደላችሁም፤ ይሁዳና ኢየሩሳሌም ሆይ፥ ተሰለፉ፤ ዝም ብላችሁ ቁሙ፤ የሚሆነውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ማዳን እዩ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ከእናንተ ጋር ነውና አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡም፤ ነገም ውጡባቸው።”
ኢዮሣፍጥም በምድር ላይ ሰገደ፤ ይሁዳም ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ወደቁ፤ ለእግዚአብሔርም ሰገዱ።
ሌዋውያንም፥ ከቀዓት ልጆችና ከቆሬ ልጆች የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ከፍ ባለ ታላቅ ድምፅ ያመሰግኑ ዘንድ ቆሙ።
ማልደውም ተነሡ፤ ወደ ቴቁሔም ምድረ በዳ ወጡ፤ ሲወጡም ኢዮሣፍጥ ቆመና፥ “ይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም የምትኖሩ ሆይ፥ ስሙኝ፤ በአምላካችሁ በእግዚአብሔር እመኑ፥ ትጸኑማላችሁ፤ በነቢዩም እመኑ፤ ነገሩም ይቀናላችኋል” አለ።
And the people, joining together before the army, said, “For His mercy endures forever; let us give thanks to the Lord,” and they stood to sing praises unto the Lord.
When they began the song and the praise, the Lord gave strength to Judah against the children of Ammon and Moab, and against the inhabitants of Mount Seir; and they were smitten.

And the children of Ammon and Moab rose up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir to destroy and to annihilate them; and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, they helped to destroy one another.
And when the men of Judah came to the watchtower in the wilderness, they looked unto the multitude; and behold, they were all dead bodies fallen to the earth; and none escaped.

And Jehoshaphat and his people came to take away the spoil of them; they found among them in abundance both riches and precious vessels, and they found more than they could carry away; and they were three days in gathering the spoil, it was so much.
And on the fourth day they assembled in the valley of Berachah; for there they blessed the Lord; therefore the name of that place was called the valley of Berachah unto this day.
And all the men of Judah, and their king Jehoshaphat, returned to Jerusalem with joy; for the Lord had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
And they came to Jerusalem with psalteries and harps and trumpets unto the house of the Lord.

And when the children of Israel saw that the Lord had fought against their enemies, the fear of the Lord was upon all the kingdoms of those countries when they had heard that the Lord fought against the enemies of Israel.
And the kingdom of Jehoshaphat was quiet; for his God gave him rest round about.
And Jehoshaphat reigned over Judah; he began to reign when he was thirty-five years old, and he reigned in Jerusalem for twenty-five years; and his mother was Azubah, the daughter of Shilhi.
And he walked in the way of his father Asa; and he did not turn aside from doing that which was right in the sight of the Lord.
Nevertheless, the high places were not taken away; for the people had not yet prepared their hearts to return unto the God of their fathers.
Now the rest of the acts of Jehoshaphat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Jehu the son of Hanani, which is mentioned in the book of the kings of Israel.
And after this, Jehoshaphat king of Judah joined himself with Ahaziah king of Israel, who did very wickedly.
And he joined him in making ships to go to Tarshish; and they made the ships in Ezion-geber.

Then Eliezer the son of Dodavah of Mareshah prophesied against Jehoshaphat, saying, "Because thou hast joined thyself with Ahaziah, the Lord hath broken thy works." And the ships were broken, that they were not able to go to Tarshish.

sections.title: King Jehoram of Judah

verses.text: ኢዮሣፍጥም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ ተቀበረ፤ ልጁም ኢዮራም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
ለእርሱም የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች አዛርያስ፥ ኢይሔል፥ ዘካርያስ፥ ዔዛርያስ፥ ሚካኤል፥ ሰፋጥያስ የሚባሉ ስድስት ወንድሞች ነበሩት፤ እነዚህ ሁሉ የይሁዳ ንጉሥ የኢዮሣፍጥ ልጆች ነበሩ።
አባታቸውም ብዙ ስጦታ፥ ብርና ወርቅ፥ የከበረም ዕቃ፥ በይሁዳም የተመሸጉትን ከተሞች ሰጣቸው፤ መንግሥቱን ግን የበኵር ልጁ ስለሆነ ለኢዮራም ሰጠው።
ኢዮራምም በአባቱ መንግሥት ላይ ተነሥቶ በጸና ጊዜ ወንድሞቹን ሁሉ፥ ሌሎችንም የእስራኤልን መሳፍንት በሰይፍ ገደለ።
ኢዮራምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሠላሳ ሁለት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ስምንት ዓመት ነገሠ።
የአክዓብንም ልጅ አግብቶ ነበርና የአክዓብ ቤት እንዳደረገ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።
ነገር ግን ከዳዊት ጋር ስላደረገው ቃል ኪዳን፥ ለእርሱና ለልጆቹም በዘመናት ሁሉ መብራትን ይሰጠው ዘንድ ስለ ሰጠው ተስፋ እግዚአብሔር የዳዊትን ቤት ያጠፋ ዘንድ አልወደደም።
በእነዚያም ዘመናት የኤዶምያስ ሰዎች በይሁዳ ላይ ዐመፁ፤ ለራሳቸውም ንጉሥ አነገሡ።
ኢዮራምም ከአለቆቹና ከሰረገሎቹ ሁሉ ጋር ተሻገረ፤ በሌሊትም ተነሥቶ እርሱንና የሰረገሎቹን አለቆች ከብበው የነበሩትን የኤዶምያስ ሰዎችን መታ፤ ሕዝቡም ወደ ድንኳናቸው ሸሹ።
ኤዶምያስ ግን በይሁዳ ላይ እስከ ዛሬ ድረስ ዐመፀ፤ በዚያም ዘመን ልብና ደግሞ በእርሱ ላይ ዐመፀ፤ የአባቶቹን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትቶ ነበርና።
And he also made monuments upon the mountains of Judah; and he caused those who dwelt in Jerusalem to be brought low; and he afflicted the people of Judah.

And from the prophet Elijah came a writing that said, “Thus saith the Lord God of thy father David, ‘Thou shalt not walk in the way of thy father Joash, nor in the way of the king of Judah, in the way of Asa.

Yet thou hast walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and hast made Judah and them that dwell in Jerusalem to err, as the house of Ahab did; and thou hast slain thy brethren, thy father’s house, who were better than thee.
Behold, the Lord shall cut off thy people and thy children, and thy wives, and all thy substance in a great plague.
And thou shalt be smitten with a grievous sickness, until thy bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day.”
And the Lord stirred up against him the Philistines and the Arabians that dwelt beside the Ethiopians.

And they went up against Judah, and broke into it; and they carried away all the substance of the king’s house, and his sons and his daughters; so that there was never a son left to him, save Jehoahaz the youngest of his sons.
And after all these things, the Lord smote him in his bowels with an incurable disease.

And it came to pass, that in the process of time, after two years, his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness: so he died of sore diseases; and his people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.

And the time that he reigned was thirty and two years; and he reigned in Jerusalem eight years; and he departed without being desired; and they buried him in the city of David, but not in the sepulchres of the kings.

sections.title: The Reign of Ahaziah

verses.text: In Jerusalem, they spoke of his young son Ahaziah, for he had been slain by them. The coming of the Arabs and the allies of the Philistines had slain his great brothers, and Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, was made king.
Ahaziah was twenty-two years old when he began to reign, and he reigned for one year in Jerusalem; and his mother was named Athaliah, the daughter of Omri.
His mother was inclined to do evil, and he also walked in the way of the house of Ahab.
And after the death of his father, he did evil in the sight of the Lord, as the house of Ahab had done; for they were his counselors after the death of his father.
He went to war with Jehoram, the son of Ahab, king of Israel, at Ramoth-gilead against Hazael, king of Syria; and the Syrians wounded Jehoram.

And when the Syrians had slain Jehoram, he turned back to Jezreel to heal from the wounds which the Syrians had inflicted upon him at Ramoth, while he fought against Hazael, king of Syria; and Ahaziah, the son of Jehoram, king of Judah, went down to see Jehoram, the son of Ahab, in Jezreel.
And when he came to Jehoram, the downfall of Ahaziah was from the Lord; for when he came, he went with Jehoram to wage war against Hazael, king of Syria, and they went to fight at Ramoth.
And the house of Ahab was destroyed, and they killed those who served Ahaziah, and they also killed his brothers who had been with him.

And they sought Ahaziah, and they caught him while he was hiding in Samaria; and they brought him to Jehu, and he killed him. And they said, “He is the son of Jehoshaphat, who sought the Lord with all his heart.” And there was none of the house of Ahaziah that could retain the kingdom.

sections.title: The mother of Ahaziah, Athaliah.

verses.text: And when the mother of Ahaziah, Athaliah, saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the seed royal of the house of Judah.

But Jehosheba, the daughter of the king, took Joash, the son of Ahaziah, and stole him from among the king's sons that were slain; and they hid him and his nurse in the bedchamber from Athaliah, so that he was not slain. Jehosheba, the daughter of King Jehoram, the sister of Ahaziah, was the wife of Jehoiada the priest; and she hid him from Athaliah, and he was not slain.
And he was with them hid in the house of God six years: and Athaliah did reign over the land.

sections.title: The reign of King Ahaziah of Judah.

verses.text: በሰባተኛውም ዓመት ኢዮአዳ በረታ፤ የመቶ አለቆቹንም፥ የኢዮራምን ልጅ አዛርያስን፥ የኢዮአናንም ልጅ እስማኤልን፥ የዖቤድንም ልጅ አዛርያን፥ የኢዳኢንም ልጅ መዓስያን፥ የዘካርያስንም ልጅ ኤሊሳፋጥን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ከእርሱ ጋር ወሰደ።
ይሁዳንም ዞሩ፤ በይሁዳም ከተሞች ሁሉ ሌዋውያንንና የእስራኤልን አባቶች ቤቶች አለቆች ሰብስበው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም መጡ።
የይሁዳም ጉባኤ ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ ከንጉሥ ጋር ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ። የንጉሥንም ልጅ አሳያቸው፤ አላቸውም፥ “እነሆ፥ እግዚአብሔር ስለ ዳዊት ቤት እንደ ተናገረ የንጉሡ ልጅ ይነግሣል።
እነሆ፥ የምታደርጉት ይህ ነው፤ በሰንበት ቀን ከምትገቡት ከእናንተ ከካህናትና ከሌዋውያን ከሦስት አንድ እጅ በመግቢያ በሮች በረኞች ሁኑ፤
ከሦስት አንድ እጅም በንጉሡ ቤት ሁኑ፤ ሌላውም ከሦስት አንድ እጅ በመካከለኛው በር ሁኑ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ ይሁኑ።
ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ግን ከካህናትና ከሌዋውያን ከሌዋውያኑም አገልጋዮች በቀር ማንም አይግባ፤ እነርሱ ቅዱሳን ናቸውና ይግቡ፤ ሕዝቡም ሁሉ የእግዚአብሔርን ትእዛዝ ይጠብቅ።
ሌዋውያንም የጦር መሣሪያቸውን በእጃቸው ይዘው ንጉሡን በዙሪያው ይክበቡት፤ ወደ ቤቱም የሚገባ ይገደል፤ ንጉሡም ሲገባና ሲወጣ ከእርሱ ጋር ሁኑ።”
ሌዋውያንና ይሁዳም ሁሉ ካህኑ ኢዮአዳ ያዘዘውን ሁሉ አደረጉ፤ ካህኑም ኢዮአዳ ሰሞነኞቹን አላሰናበተም ነበርና እያንዳንዱ ከሰንበት መጀመሪያ እስከ ሰንበት መጨረሻ ሰዎችን ወሰደ።
ካህኑም ኢዮአዳ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የነበረውን የንጉሡን የዳዊትን ሰይፍና ጦር፥ አላባሽ አግሬውንም ጋሻ ለመቶ አለቆች ሰጣቸው።
ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እያንዳንዱ የጦር መሣሪያውን በእጁ እየያዘ በንጉሡ ዙሪያ ከቤተ መቅደሱ ቀኝ እስከ ቤተ መቅደሱ ግራ ድረስ በመሠዊያውና በመቅደሱ አጠገብ እንዲቆም አደረገ።
የንጉሡንም ልጅ አውጥቶ ዘውዱን ጫነበት፤ ምስክሩንም ሰጠው፤ አነገሡትም፤ ኢዮአዳና ልጆቹም አነገሡት፥ “ንጉሡ በሕይወት ይኑር” እያሉም ቀቡት።
ጎቶልያም የሚሮጡትንና ንጉሡን የሚያመሰግኑትን የሕዝቡን ድምፅ በሰማች ጊዜ ወደ ሕዝቡ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት መጣች።
እነሆም፥ ንጉሡ በመግቢያው በዓምዱ አጠገብ ሆኖ በንጉሡም ዙሪያ አለቆችና መለከተኞች፥ መኳንንትም ቆመው አየች። ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ደስ ብሎአቸው መለከቱን ይነፉ ነበር፤ መዘምራንም በዜማ ዕቃ እያዜሙ የምስጋና መዝሙር ይዘምሩ ነበር። ጎቶልያም ልብስዋን ቀድዳ፥ “ዐመፅ ነው! ዐመፅ ነው!” ብላ ጮኸች።
ካህኑም ኢዮአዳ ወጥቶ በጭፍራው ላይ የተሾሙትን አለቆችና የመቶ አለቆች፥ “ከቤተ እግዚአብሔር ወደ ውጭ አውጡአት፤ የሚከተላትም በሰይፍ ይገደል” ብሎ አዘዛቸው። ካህኑ፥ “በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ አትገደል” ብሎአልና።
ገለልም ብለው አሳለፉአት፤ እርስዋም ወደ ፈረሱ በር መግቢያ ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት ሄደች፤ በዚያም ገደሉአት።
ካህኑ ኢዮአዳም በእርሱና በሕዝቡ ሁሉ፥ በንጉሡም መካከል የእግዚአብሔር ሕዝብ ይሆኑ ዘንድ ቃል ኪዳን አደረገ።
የሀገሩም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወደ በዓል ቤት ሄደው አፈረሱት፤ መሠዊያዎቹንና ምስሎቹንም አደቀቁ፤ የበዓልንም ካህን ማታንን በመሠዊያው ፊት ገደሉት።
ካህኑ ኢዮአዳም በሙሴ ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈው እንደ ዳዊት ትእዛዝ በደስታና በመዝሙር ለእግዚአብሔር የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት የከፈላቸውን ካህናትና ሌዋውያን በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ላይ ሾመ።
በማናቸውም ነገር ሁሉ ርኩስ የሆነ ሰው እንዳይገባ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር በረኞችን አኖረ።
የመቶ አለቆችንም፥ ከበርቴዎችንም፥ የሕዝቡንም አለቆች፥ የሀገሩንም ሕዝብ ሁሉ ወሰደ፤ ንጉሡንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አወረዱት፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት በውስጠኛው በር በኩል ወደ ንጉሡ ቤት አመጡት፤ ንጉሡንም በመንግሥቱ ዙፋን ላይ አስቀመጡት።
And all the people of the land rejoiced; and the city was at peace; for they had slain Goliath with the sword.

sections.title: The Reign of Joash

verses.text: ኢዮአስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሰባት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አርባ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ ሳብያ የተባለች የቤርሳቤህ ሴት ነበረች።
ኢዮአስም በካህኑ በኢዮአዳ ዘመን ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ።
ኢዮአዳም ሁለት ሚስቶችን አጋባው፤ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ወለደ።
ከዚህም በኋላ ኢዮአስ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ይጠግን ዘንድ አሰበ።
ካህናትንና ሌዋውያንንም ሰብስቦ፥ “ወደ ይሁዳ ከተሞች ውጡ፤ የአምላካችሁንም ቤት በየዓመቱ ለማደስ የሚበቃ ከእስራኤል ሁሉ ገንዘብን ሰብስቡ፤ ነገሩንም ፈጥናችሁ አድርጉ” አላቸው። ሌዋውያን ግን አላፋጠኑም።
ንጉሡ ኢዮአስም አለቃውን ኢዮአዳን ጠርቶ፥ “የእግዚአብሔር ባሪያ ሙሴ እስራኤልን በምስክሩ ድንኳን በሰበሰበ ጊዜ እንዲያዋጣ ያዘዘውን ግብር ከይሁዳና ከኢየሩሳሌም ያመጡ ዘንድ ስለ ምን ሌዋውያንን አልተከታተልህም?” አለው።
ጎቶልያ ከሐዲት ነበረችና ልጆችዋም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አፍርሰዋልና፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ተቀድሶ የነበረውን ሁሉ ለበኣሊም ሰጥተዋልና።
ንጉሡም ሣጥን ሠርተው በእግዚአብሔር ቤት በር አጠገብ በስተውጭ ያኖሩት ዘንድ አዘዘ።
የእግዚአብሔርም ባሪያ ሙሴ በምድረ በዳ በእስራኤል ላይ ያዘዘውን ግብር ለእግዚአብሔር ያመጡ ዘንድ፥ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ያስተምሩ ዘንድ አዘዘ።
አለቆቹና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ ሰጡ፤ እስኪሞላም ድረስ በሣጥኑ ውስጥ አስገቡት።

And when the offerings were brought to the king by the hands of the Levites, and they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the chief priests were coming forth, taking the money from the offerings; and the Levites would return to their place. Thus they did daily, gathering much money.

The king and Jehoiada gave to those who were set over the work of the house of the Lord; and they were to give to the workers who cleansed the house of the Lord, to the masons and the carpenters who were to build the house of the Lord.
The workers labored, and all the work was accomplished by their hands; and the house of the Lord was restored to its former state, and they stood firm.

And at the end of the time, they brought the money that was left to the king and to the priest Jehoiada; and they gave it for the vessels of the house of the Lord, for the service and for the burnt offerings, for the vessels of the sanctuary, and for gold and silver vessels. In the days of Jehoiada, they were to offer continually the burnt offerings in the house of the Lord.
Jehoiada grew old and was full of days, and he died; and at his death, he was one hundred and thirty years old.
And he had done well with Israel, and with God and His house, and they buried him in the city of David with the kings, because he had done good in Israel and toward God and His house.
After the death of Jehoiada, the leaders of Judah came and bowed down to the king; and the king listened to them.
And they forsook the house of the Lord God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols; and wrath came upon Judah and Jerusalem because of their trespass.
And they would return to the Lord, and He would send prophets to them to bring them back; and they testified against them, but they would not listen.

And the Spirit of God came upon Zechariah the son of Jehoiada the priest, and he stood above the people and said to them, "Thus says God: 'Why do you transgress the commandments of the Lord, so that you cannot prosper? Because you have forsaken the Lord, He also has forsaken you.'"
And they ran to him, and the king commanded, within the house of the Lord, that they should be stoned.
Likewise, King Joash did not remember the kindness which his father Jehoiada had shown him; and he killed his son Zechariah. And as he died, he said, "The Lord look upon it, and require it."

And after the year had passed, the army of the Syrians came up; and they came to Judah and to Jerusalem and killed all the princes of the people among them; and they sent all their plunder to the king of Damascus.

And the army of the Syrians was small in number; but the Lord delivered a great and mighty army into their hand, because they had forsaken the Lord God of their fathers. And they executed judgment against Joash.

And when they had departed from him, for he was severely wounded, his own servants conspired against him because of the blood of the sons of Jehoiada the priest, and they killed him on his bed; and he died, and they buried him in the city of David, but they did not bury him in the sepulchers of the kings.
And those who killed him were Zabad the son of Shimeath, an Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith, a Moabitess.
Now concerning his sons, and the greatness laid upon him, and the repairing of the house of God, behold, they are written in the history of the kings. And his son Amaziah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The reign of Amaziah, king of Judah.

verses.text: አሜስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ አምስት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሃያ ዘጠኝ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱ ኢዮዓዲን የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ፤ ነገር ግን በፍጹም ልብ አይደለም።
መንግሥትም በእጁ በጸናለት ጊዜ ንጉሡን አባቱን የገደሉትን ባሪያዎች ገደለ።
እንደ እግዚአብሔር ሕግ ቃል ኪዳን እንደ ተጻፈ፥ እግዚአብሔርም፥ “ሰው ሁሉ በገዛ ኀጢአቱ ይሙት እንጂ አባቶች በልጆቻቸው፥ ልጆችም በአባቶቻቸው ፋንታ አይሙቱ” ብሎ እንዳዘዘ ልጆቻቸውን ግን አልገደለም።

sections.title: The War Waged Against Edom.

verses.text: ንጉሡ አሜስያስም የይሁዳን ሕዝብ ሰበሰበ፤ እንደ እየአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አቆማቸው፤ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ሁሉ የሽህ አለቆችንና የመቶ አለቆችን አደረገ፤ ከሃያ ዓመት ጀምሮ ከዚያም በላይ ያሉትን ሁሉ ቈጠረ፤ ለሰልፍም የሚወጡ፥ ጋሻና ጦርም የሚይዙ ሦስት መቶ ሺህ የተመረጡ ሰዎችን አገኘ።
ደግሞም ከእስራኤል ዘንድ መቶ ሺህ ጽኑዓን ኀያላን ሰዎችን በመቶ መክሊት ብር ቀጠረ።
አንድ የእግዚአብሔር ሰው ግን ወደ እርሱ መጥቶ፥ “ንጉሥ ሆይ፥ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤልና ከኤፍሬም ልጆች ሁሉ ጋር አይደለምና የእስራኤል ጭፍራ ከአንተ ጋር አይውጣ።
ብትሄድ ግን፥ በእነርሱም ማሸነፍን ብታስብ፥ የማጽናትና የመጣል ኀይል ከእግዚአብሔር ዘንድ ነውና እግዚአብሔር በጠላቶችህ ፊት ይጥልሃል” አለው።
አሜስያስም የእግዚአብሔርን ሰው፥ “ለእስራኤል ጭፍራ የሰጠሁት መቶ መክሊት ምን ይሁን?” አለው። የእግዚአብሔርም ሰው፥ “ከዚህ አብልጦ ይሰጥህ ዘንድ ለእግዚአብሔር አይሳነውም” ብሎ መለሰለት።
ንጉሡ አሜስያስም ከኤፍሬም ከተሞች የመጡ ጭፍሮች ወደ ስፍራቸው ይመለሱ ዘንድ ለይቶ አሰናበታቸው፤ ስለዚህም ቍጣቸው በይሁዳ ላይ ጸና፤ ወደ ስፍራቸውም በጽኑ ቍጣ ተመለሱ።
አሜስያስም በረታ፤ ሕዝቡንም ሰብስቦ ወደ ጨው ሸለቆ ሄደ፤ ከሴይርም ልጆች ዐሥር ሺህ ገደለ።
የይሁዳም ልጆች ደግሞ ዐሥር ሺህ ሰዎችን ማረኩ። ወደ ዐለቱም ራስ ላይ አመጡአቸው፤ ከዐለቱም ራስ ላይ ጣሉአቸው፤ ሁሉም ተፈጠፈጡ።
አሜስያስ ግን ከእርሱ ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ እንዳይሄዱ ያሰናበታቸው ጭፍሮችም ከሰማርያ ጀምረው እስከ ቤትሮን ድረስ በይሁዳ ከተሞች ላይ አደጋ ጣሉ፤ ከእነርሱም ሦስት ሺህ ገደሉ፤ ብዙም ምርኮ ማረኩ።
አሜስያስም የኤዶምያስን ሰዎች ከገደለ በኋላ የሴይርን ልጆች አማልክት አመጣ፤ የእርሱም አማልክት ይሆኑ ዘንድ አቆማቸው፤ በፊታቸውም ይሰግድላቸውና ይሠዋላቸው ነበር።
Therefore, the anger of the Lord came upon the king, Amaziah; and He sent a prophet unto him, saying, “Why dost thou seek the gods of the people whom thou hast not delivered from thy hand?”

And as he spake this, the king Amaziah said, “Art thou made the king's counselor? Beware lest thou incur the king's wrath.” And the prophet answered, “I have done this, and thou hast not hearkened unto my counsel; behold, I know that the Lord hath devised to destroy thee.” Thus he held his peace.

sections.title: The war that was waged between Judah and Israel.

verses.text: And Amaziah, king of Judah, took counsel, saying, "Come, let us face one another in battle," and he sent messengers to Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, the son of Jehu, king of Israel.

And Joash, king of Israel, sent to Amaziah, king of Judah, saying, "The thistle that was in Lebanon sent to the cedar that is in Lebanon, saying, 'Give your daughter to my son as a wife.' And a wild beast that was in Lebanon passed by and trampled down the thistle."

And thou, behold, thou hast said in thy heart, "I have prevailed against Edom," and thou art lifted up in thy heart; abide in thy house. Why shouldest thou meddle to thine own hurt, that thou shouldest fall, even thou, and Judah with thee?
And because they sought after the gods of Edom, the Lord delivered them into the hand of their enemies, and this was from the Lord, yet Amaziah did not listen.
And Joash, king of Israel, went up; and he and Amaziah, king of Judah, met at Beth-shemesh, which belongeth to Judah.
And Judah was put to the worse before Israel, and they fled every man to their tents.

And Joash, king of Israel, took Amaziah, the son of Joash, the son of Ahaziah, king of Judah, at Beth-shemesh, and brought him to Jerusalem, and broke down the wall of Jerusalem from the gate of Ephraim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
And he took all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of God with Obed-edom, and the treasures of the king's house, and the hostages, and returned to Samaria.
And Amaziah, the son of Joash, king of Judah, lived after the death of Joash, the son of Jehoahaz, king of Israel, fifteen years.
Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, are they not written in the book of the kings of Judah and Israel?

Amaziah, having turned away from following the Lord, did wickedly in Jerusalem, and he set up the altar of the gods of the Ammonites; and he offered sacrifices to them, and he sent to the king of Israel, and there they were slain.
And they came with their horses and chariots; and they dwelt in the city of David with their fathers.

sections.title: The reign of King Uzziah of Judah.

verses.text: የይሁዳም ሕዝብ ሁሉ የዐሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጐልማሳ የነበረውን ዖዝያንን ወስደው በአባቱ በአሜስያስ ፋንታ አነገሡት።
ንጉሥ አባቱም ከአባቶቹ ጋር ከአንቀላፋ በኋላ ዖዝያን ኤላትን ሠራ፤ ወደ ይሁዳም መለሳት።
ዖዝያንም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የዐሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም አምሳ ሁለት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ኢዮኮልያስ የተባለች የኢየሩሳሌም ሴት ነበረች።
አባቱም አሜስያስ እንዳደረገው ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገርን አደረገ።
እግዚአብሔርንም መፍራት ባስተማረ በዘካርያስ ዘመን እግዚአብሔርን ይፈልግ ዘንድ ልብ አደረገ፤ በዘመኑም እግዚአብሔርን ፈለገ፤ እግዚአብሔርም ነገሩን አከናወነለት።
ወጥቶም ከፍልስጥኤማውያን ጋር ተዋጋ፤ የጌትን ቅጥር፥ የኢያቢስንም ቅጥር፥ የአዛጦንንም ቅጥር አፈረሰ፤ በአዛጦንና በፍልስጥኤማውያንም ሀገር ከተሞችን ሠራ።
እግዚአብሔርም በፍልስጥኤማውያንና በዓለት ላይ በሚኖሩ ዓረባውያን፥ በምዕዑናውያንም ላይ አጸናው።
አሞናውያንም ለዖዝያን ገበሩ፤ እጅግም በርትቶ ነበርና ዝናው እስከ ግብፅ መግቢያ ድረስ ተሰማ።
ዖዝያንም በኢየሩሳሌም በማዕዘኑ በርና በሸለቆው በር፥ ቅጥሩም በዞረበት ማዕዘን አጠገብ ግንቦችን ሠርቶ መሸጋቸው።
በምድረ በዳውም ግንቦችን ሠራ፤ ብዙ ጕድጓድም ማሰ፤ በቆላውና በደጋው ብዙ እንስሶች ነበሩትና፤ ደግሞም እርሻ ይወድድ ነበርና በተራራማውና በፍሬያማው ስፍራ አራሾችና የወይን አትክልተኞች ነበሩት።
ደግሞም ለዖዝያን የሰልፍ ሠራዊት ነበሩት፤ በንጉሡ አለቃ በሐናንያ ትእዛዝ፥ በአለቃው በመዕሤያና በጸሓፊው በኢዮሔል እጅ እንደ ተቈጠሩ ወደ ሰልፍ በየቍጥራቸው ይወጡ ነበር።
የአባቶቻቸውም ቤቶች አለቆች በሰልፍ ጽኑዓንና ኀያላን የሆኑ ሁሉ ቍጥራቸው ሁለት ሺህ ስድስት መቶ ነበረ።
ከእነርሱም ጋር ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡ ሦስት መቶ ሰባት ሺህ አምስት መቶ ሠራዊት ነበሩ፤ እነዚህም ንጉሡን በጠላቱ ላይ የሚያግዙ፥ በታላቅ ኀይል ወደ ሰልፍ የሚወጡ ጽኑዓን ነበሩ።
ዖዝያንም ለጭፍራው ሁሉ ጋሻና ጦር፥ ራስ ቍርና ጥሩር፥ ቀስትና የሚወነጭፉትን ድንጋይ አዘጋጀላቸው።
በኢየሩሳሌምም በብልሃተኞች እጅ የተሠሩትን ፥ በግንብና በቅጥር ላይ የሚኖሩትን፥ ፍላጻና መርግ የሚወረወርባቸውን መሣሪያዎች አደረገ፤ እስኪበረታም ድረስ እግዚአብሔር በድንቅ ረድቶታልና የመሣሪያዎቹ ዝና እስከ ሩቅ ድረስ ተሰማ።
ነገር ግን በበረታ ጊዜ ለጥፋት ልቡ ታበየ፤ አምላኩንም እግዚአብሔርን በደለ፤ በዕጣን መሠዊያውም ላይ ያጥን ዘንድ ወደ መቅደስ ገባ።
ካህኑም ዓዛርያስ፥ ከእርሱም ጋር ጽኑዓን የነበሩ ሰማንያ የእግዚአብሔር ካህናት ተከትለው ገቡ።
ንጉሡንም ዖዝያንን እየተቃወሙ፥ “ዖዝያን ሆይ፥ ዕጣን ማጠን ለተቀደሱት ለአሮን ልጆች ለካህናቱ ነው እንጂ ለእግዚአብሔር ታጥን ዘንድ ለአንተ አይገባህም፤ ከእግዚአብሔር ርቀሃልና ከመቅደሱ ውጣ፤ ይህም በአምላክ በእግዚአብሔርም ዘንድ ለአንተ ክብር አይሆንህም” አሉት።
ዖዝያንም ተቈጣ፤ በመቅደስም የሚያጥንበት ጥና በእጁ ነበረ፤ ካህናቱንም በተቈጣ ጊዜ በካህናቱ ፊት በእግዚአብሔር ቤት ውስጥ በዕጣኑ መሠዊያ አጠገብ ሳለ በግንባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ታየ።
ታላቁ ካህን ዓዛርያስ፥ ካህናቱም ሁሉ ተመለከቱት፤ እነሆም፥ በግንባሩ ላይ ለምጽ ነበረ፤ ፈጥነውም አባረሩት፤ እርሱም ደግሞ እግዝአብሔር ቀሥፎት ነበርና ይወጣ ዘንድ ቸኰለ።
ንጉሡም ዖዝያን እስኪሞት ድረስ ለምጻም ነበረ፤ ለምጻምም ሆኖ ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ርቆአልና በተለየ ቤት ይቀመጥ ነበር፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በቤተ መንግሥቱ ሆኖ በምድሩ ሕዝብ ላይ ይፈርድ ነበር።
የቀሩትም የፊተኞቹና የኋለኞቹ የዖዝያን ነገሮች በነቢዩ በኢሳይያስ መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል።
ዖዝያንም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ ለምጻም ነው ብለዋልና የነገሥታቱ መቃብር ባልሆነ እርሻ ውስጥ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም ኢዮአታም በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።

sections.title: The reign of Jehoash.

verses.text: And Joatham began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. And his mother was named Jerusha, the daughter of Zadok.

And his father Uzziah had done all that was right in the sight of the Lord, according to all that his father had done; yet he entered not into the temple of the Lord. And the people still corrupted themselves.
He made the upper gate of the house of the Lord, and much work was done upon the wall of Ophel.
And he built cities in the mountainous region of Judah, and in the forest he built castles and towers.

And he fought with the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. And in that year the children of Ammon gave him a hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand measures of barley. Thus did the children of Ammon pay unto him in the second and third year also.
And Joatham prepared his ways before the Lord his God, for he walked in the ways of the Lord.
Now the rest of the acts of Joatham, and all his wars, and his works, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.
And he began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem.
And Joatham slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of David; and his son Ahaz reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The reign of Ahaz, king of Judah.
