verses.text: አካዝም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ዐሥራ ስድስት ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እንደ አባቱም እንደ ዳዊት በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ቅን ነገር አላደረገም።
ነገር ግን በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መንገድ ሄደ፤ ደግሞም ቀልጠው የተሠሩትን ምስሎች ሠራ።
ደግሞም በሄኖም ልጅ ሸለቆ ውስጥ ለምስሉ ሠዋ፤ እግዚአብሔር ከእስራኤል ልጆች ፊት እንዳሳደዳቸው እንደ አሕዛብም ክፉ ልማድ ልጆቹን በእሳት አቃጠለ።
በኮረብታው መስገጃዎችና በተራሮች ላይ በለመለመውም ዛፍ ሁሉ በታች ያጥን ነበር።
ስለዚህ አምላኩ እግዚአብሔር በሶርያ ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም መታው፤ ከእርሱም ብዙ ምርኮኞችን ወሰደ፤ ወደ ደማስቆም አመጣው። ደግሞም በእስራኤል ንጉሥ እጅ አሳልፎ ሰጠው፤ እርሱም በታላቅ አመታት መታው።
የአባቶቻቸውንም አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን ትተው ነበርና የእስራኤል ንጉሥ የሮሜልዩ ልጅ ፋቁሔ በአንድ ቀን ከይሁዳ ጽኑዓን የነበሩ መቶ ሃያ ሺህ ሰልፈኞችን ገደለ፤
ከኤፍሬም ወገን የነበረው ኀያል ሰው ዝክሪም የንጉሡን ልጅ ማዓሥያንና የቤቱን አዛዥ ዓዝሪቃምን፥ ለንጉሡም በማዕርግ ሁለተኛ የሆነውን ሕልቃናን ገደለ።
የእስራኤል ልጆች ከወንድሞቻቸው ሦስት መቶ ሺህ ሴቶችን፥ ወንዶችና ሴቶች ልጆችንም ማረኩ፤ እጅግም ምርኮ ከእነርሱ ወስደው ወደ ሰማርያ አገቡ።
በዚያም ዖዴድ የተባለ የእግዚአብሔር ነቢይ ነበረ፤ ወደ ሰማርያም የሚመጣውን ጭፍራ ሊገናኘው ወጣ፤ እንዲህም አላቸው፤ “እነሆ፥ የአባቶቻችሁ አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ይሁዳን ስለ ተቈጣ በእጃችሁ አሳልፎ ሰጣቸው፤ እናንተም ወደ ሰማይ በሚደርስ ቍጣ ገደላችኋቸው።
አሁንም የይሁዳንና የኢየሩሳሌምን ልጆች ባሪያዎች አድርገን እንግዛ ትላላችሁ፤ የፈጣሪያችሁ የእግዚአብሔር ምስክር የምሆን እኔም ከእናንተ ጋር ያለሁ አይደለምን?
Now hear this; the wrath of the Lord has risen against you, and you have been delivered from your brethren, return to the reproaches that they have cast upon you.

And likewise, from the children of Ephraim, the leaders were Azariah the son of Anan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, Hezekiah the son of Shalom, and Amaziah the son of Adaliah; they contended against those who had returned from the captivity.

"Moreover, you have committed sin before the Lord, and your iniquities and transgressions have multiplied against us, and do not let those who have been instructed come near to this; for our iniquities are great, and the wrath of the Lord is upon Israel," they said to them.
And the captains cast down the reproaches and the reproach before all the leaders and the assembly.

And those whose names were written arose and took the reproaches; and among them, they stripped off their raiment that was upon them; they also girded themselves; they put on shoes upon their feet; they entered in and cleansed themselves; they washed their garments; they put on their robes; and all the weak they placed upon the beasts; they brought them to the city of Jericho and to their brethren; and they returned to Samaria.

sections.title: King Ahaz sought the help of the king of Assyria.

verses.text: In that time, King Ahaz sought help and sent to the king of Assyria;
The people of Edom came in battle, and they struck Judah, and there was much devastation and ruin.

Moreover, the Philistines dwelt in the cities of Judah, in the lowland and in the south, and they laid waste to the cities of Judah, including Beth-shemesh and Aijalon, Gederoth and Soco, and the villages thereof, and Timnah and the villages thereof, and Gimzo and the villages thereof, and they dwelt there.
And in Judah, because of King Ahaz, the Lord brought Judah low; for he had greatly forsaken the Lord.
And the king of Assyria, Tiglath-pileser, came and distressed him.

And Ahaz gathered together the vessels of the house of the Lord, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of the king, and of the princes, and gave them to the king of Assyria; yet he helped him not.
And King Ahaz was utterly unfaithful to the Lord.

And the king said, "I will seek the gods of Damascus, which have smitten me; for they are the gods of the kings of Syria, and I will sacrifice to them, that they may help me." But they were the ruin of him and of all Israel.
And Ahaz gathered together all the vessels of the house of the Lord, and cut them in pieces; and he shut the doors of the house of the Lord, and made him altars in every corner of Jerusalem.
And in all the cities of Judah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked the Lord God of his fathers to anger.
And behold, the matters that remain and all the works, both of the former and of the latter, are written in the book of the kings of Judah and of Israel.
And Ahaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of David; yet they brought him not into the sepulchers of the kings of Israel; and his son Hezekiah reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The reign of Hezekiah, king of Judah.

verses.text: And Hezekiah reigned for twenty-five years in Jerusalem; and his mother's name was Abi, the daughter of Zechariah.
And his father David did all that was right in the sight of the Lord.

sections.title: The cleansing of the temple.

verses.text: And in the kingdom, in the time of the siege, in the first month, they broke open the doors of the house of the Lord; and they prepared them.
And he brought forth the priests and the Levites, and gathered them in the east square.
And he said unto them, “Hear me, O Levites; sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of the Lord God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.”
For our fathers have trespassed, and done evil in the sight of the Lord our God, and have forsaken Him, and turned away their faces from the habitation of the Lord, and turned their backs.
Moreover, they have shut up the doors of the house of the Lord, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place unto the God of Israel.
“Wherefore the wrath of the Lord was upon Judah and Jerusalem; and He hath delivered them to trouble, to astonishment, and to hissing, as ye see with your eyes.”

Behold, for this cause, your fathers have fallen by the sword; and your sons and your daughters, and your wives are in captivity, and they are in a land that is not theirs; and even unto this day they remain there.
Now, therefore, it is in my heart to make a covenant with the Lord God of Israel, that His fierce wrath may turn away from us.
Now be ye not negligent; for the Lord hath chosen you to stand before Him, to serve Him, and that ye should minister unto Him, and burn incense unto Him.”

And of the Levites, from the children of Kohath, there was Amassai the son of Abdi; and of the children of Merari, there was Joel the son of Azariah; and of the children of Gershom, there was Zimri the son of Jehoahaz; and of the children of Gedson, there was Joah the son of Zimri, and of Joah, the son of Jehoahaz.
ከኤልሳፋንም ልጆች ሳምሪና ኢዮሔል፥ ከአሳፍም ልጆች ዘካርያስና ማታንያስ፤
ከኤማንም ልጆች ኢዮሔልና ሰሜኢ፥ ከኢዱቱንም ልጆች ሰማዕያና ኡዝሔል ተነሡ።
ወንድሞቻቸውንም ሰብስበው በእግዚአብሔር ቃል እንደ ንጉሡ ትእዛዝ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ያነጹ ዘንድ ራሳቸውን አነጹ።
ካህናቱም ያነጹት ዘንድ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወደ ውስጥ ገቡ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም መቅደስ ያገኙትን ርኩስ ነገር ሁሉ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ አወጡት። ሌዋውያንም ወስደው ወደ ሜዳ ወደ ቄድሮን ወንዝ ጣሉት።
በመጀመሪያውም ወር በመጀመሪያው ቀን ያነጹ ጀመር፤ በዚያውም ወር በስምንተኛው ቀን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት ወለል ደረሱ፤ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በስምንት ቀን አነጹ፤ በመጀመሪያውም ወር በዐሥራ ስድስተኛው ቀን ፈጸሙ።
ወደ ውስጡም ወደ ንጉሡ ወደ ሕዝቅያስ ገብተው፥ “የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ሁሉ፥ ለሚቃጠል መሥዋዕት የሚሆነውን መሠዊያና ዕቃውንም ሁሉ፥ የኅብስተ ገጹንም ገበታና ዕቃውን ሁሉ አንጽተናል፤
ንጉሡም አካዝ ነግሦ ሳለ በመተላለፉ ያረከሰውን ዕቃ ሁሉ አዘጋጅተናል፤ ቀድሰናልም፤ እነሆም፥ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ፊት ሆነዋል” አሉት።
ንጉሡም ሕዝቅያስ ማልዶ ተነሣ፤ የእስራኤልንም ቤት አለቆች ሰበሰበ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ቤት ወጣ።
ስለ መንግሥቱና ስለ መቅደሱም፥ ስለ ሕዝቡም ስለ እስራኤል ለኀጢአት መሥዋዕት ሰባት ወይፈኖች፥ ሰባትም አውራ በጎች፥ ሰባትም የበግ ጠቦቶች፥ ሰባትም አውራ ፍየሎች አመጡ። የአሮንንም ልጆች ካህናቱን፥ “ወደ እግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ውጡ” አላቸው።
ወይፈኖቹንም አረዱ፤ ካህናቱም ደሙን ተቀብለው በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት፤ አውራ በጎቹንም አረዱ፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት፤ ጠቦቶቹንም አረዱ፤ ደሙንም በመሠዊያው ላይ ረጩት።
They brought forth the great offerings of sin before the king and his assembly; and they laid their hands upon them.
And the priests did their part; for the king commanded that the offerings for sin and the offerings of atonement be made for all Israel, and they offered their blood upon the altar for all Israel.

This command was given by the Lord through His prophets, as David and the king had seen, as Gad the seer had commanded, and as the prophet Nathan had given the command, that they should be cleansed and sanctified, and the Levites should stand before the Lord.
And the Levites bore the instruments of the song of David, and the priests stood with the trumpets.

Hezekiah said, "Prepare the offerings for sin upon the altar," and when the offerings for sin began to be prepared, the psalm of the Lord also began; and the priests blew the trumpets, and the king of Israel struck the instruments of the song of David.
And the offerings for sin were to be completed, and all the assembly was to worship; and the singers sang, and the Levites played.
And when they had made the offering, the king and all who were with him bowed down and worshipped.
The king Hezekiah and the leaders commanded the Levites to praise the Lord with the words of David and of the prophet, and they praised with joy; and they bowed down and worshipped.

And Hezekiah said, "Now sanctify your hands to the Lord and bring the offerings and the peace offerings to the house of the Lord," and he spoke. And the assembly brought the offerings and the peace offerings to the house of the Lord; and all whose hearts were willing brought the offerings for sin.
And the assembly brought forth the offerings for sin, a number of seventy bulls and one hundred rams, and two hundred goats; all these were offerings for sin unto the Lord.
የተቀደሱትም ቍጥር ስድስት መቶ በሬዎች፥ ሦስት ሺህም በጎች ነበረ።
ነገር ግን ካህናቱ ጥቂቶች ነበሩና የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለመግፈፍ አይችሉም ነበር፤ ስለዚህም ሌዋውያን በቅን ልብ ከካህናት ይልቅ ይቀደሱ ነበርና ሥራው እስኪፈጸም ድረስ፥ ካህናቱም እስኪቀደሱ ድረስ ወንድሞቻቸው ሌዋውያን ያግዙአቸው ነበር።
የሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ከደኅንነቱ መሥዋዕት ስብና ለሚቃጠለውም መሥዋዕት ከሚቀርበው የመጠጥ ቍርባን ጋር ብዙ ነበረ። እንዲሁም የእግዚአብሔር ቤት አገልግሎት ተዘጋጀ።
ሕዝቅያስና ሕዝቡም ሁሉ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡ ስላዘጋጀው ነገር ደስ አላቸው። ይህ ነገር በድንገት ተደርጎአልና።

sections.title: The observance of the Passover in the time of Hezekiah.

verses.text: And for Israel, the Lord commanded that they should keep the Passover unto the Lord, and that they should come to the house of the Lord in Jerusalem. Hezekiah sent messengers to all Israel and Judah; and also he wrote letters to Ephraim and Manasseh.
The king and his leaders encouraged all the assembly of Israel that was in Jerusalem to keep the Passover in the second month.
Because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, and the people had not gathered in Jerusalem at the appointed time, they were unable to perform it.
And it was a matter of great joy for the king and all the assembly.
As it was written, many of them did not keep it; therefore, a decree was issued that all Israel should come to Jerusalem to keep the Passover unto the Lord God of Israel, from Beer-sheba to Dan.

And according to the command of the king, the messengers went with letters from the king and his leaders to all Israel and Judah, saying, "Children of Israel, return unto the Lord God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, that He may return to you from the captivity of the kings of Assyria."
And you, as you see, do not be like your fathers, who forsook the Lord God; and do not be like your brothers, who were given to destruction.

Now do not be stiff-necked as your fathers were; but yield yourselves unto the Lord, and enter into His sanctuary, which He has sanctified forever, and serve the Lord your God, that His fierce wrath may turn away from you.

For your God, the Lord, is gracious and merciful; and if you return to Him, He will not turn His face away from you. If you return to the Lord, your brothers and your children will find mercy before Him, and He will return you to this land.
And the messengers went from city to city through the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, even unto Zebulun; but they laughed them to scorn and mocked them.
Nevertheless, from the descendants of Asher and Manasseh, and from Zebulun, the people did not humble themselves; and they came to Jerusalem.
And they were to give one heart to them, to do according to the word of the Lord, the command of the king and of the princes, that the hand of the Lord might be upon them.
In the second month, to keep the feast of unleavened bread, a great multitude gathered in Jerusalem; indeed, it was a very great assembly.
And they arose and removed all the altars that were in Jerusalem, and all the incense altars they cast into the brook Kidron.

In the second month, on the fourteenth day of the month, they kept the Passover; and the priests and the Levites were sanctified and cleansed. And they brought the sacrifices and offerings to the house of the Lord.
As the Lord commanded, the people stood in their places and according to their divisions; and the priests sprinkled the blood received from the hand of the Levites.
And many people were not cleansed at the assembly; therefore, the Levites had to slaughter the Passover for everyone who was not clean to consecrate it to the Lord.
And contrary to the command, from Ephraim and Manasseh, from Issachar and Zebulun, many people did not cleanse themselves, and they ate the Passover.
And Hezekiah prayed for them, saying, “May the good Lord pardon everyone who prepares his heart to seek God, the Lord God of his fathers, though not according to the purification of the sanctuary.”
And the Lord heard Hezekiah, and healed the people.

And the children of Israel who were found in Jerusalem, each day, gave thanks to the Lord with great joy, celebrating the feast of unleavened bread for seven days; the Levites and the priests sang praises to the Lord with instruments.

Hezekiah also strengthened all the Levites who served in the house of the Lord. They brought forth the offerings of safety, and while giving thanks to the God of their fathers, they celebrated the feast for seven days.
The assembly was encouraged to celebrate the feast for seven days, and with joy, they celebrated the feast for seven days.

King Hezekiah provided for the assembly one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep for the sacrifices; and the leaders offered one thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep for the assembly; and many of the priests were sanctified.
And all the assembly of Judah, with the priests and the Levites, and all who came from Israel, and the strangers who dwelt among them in Judah rejoiced.
And there was great joy in Jerusalem; for from the days of Solomon the son of David, king of Israel, there had been nothing like this in Jerusalem.
And the priests and the Levites arose and blessed the people; and their voice was heard, and their prayer ascended to His holy dwelling, to heaven.
ይህም ሁሉ በተፈጸመ ጊዜ በይሁዳ ከተሞች የተገኙ እስራኤል ሁሉ ወጥተው ዐምዶቹን ሰበሩ፤ ዐፀዶችንም ኮረብታዎችንም አፈረሱ፤ መሠዊያውንም አጠፉ። በይሁዳና በብንያምም ሁሉ ደግሞም በኤፍሬምና በምናሴ የነበሩትን ፈጽመው እስከ ዘለዓለሙ አጠፉአቸው። የእስራኤልም ልጆች ሁሉ ወደ ርስታቸውና ወደ ከተሞቻቸው ተመለሱ።
ሕዝቅያስም የካህናትንና የሌዋውያንን ሰሞን በየክፍላቸውና በየአገልግሎታቸው፥ በእግዚአብሔር ቤት አደባባይ በሮች የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና የደኅንነቱን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡና ያገለግሉ ዘንድ፥ ያመሰግኑም፥ ያከብሩም ዘንድ ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን መደበ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ሕግ እንደ ተጻፈ በጥዋትና በማታ በሰንበታቱም፥ በመባቻዎቹም፥ በበዓላትም ለሚቀርበው ለሚቃጠለው መሥዋዕት ንጉሡ ከገንዘቡ የሚከፍለውን ወሰነ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ለአገልግሎት እንዲጸኑ ለካህናቱና ለሌዋውያን ድርሻቸውን ይሰጡ ዘንድ በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ሕዝብ አዘዘ።
ይህንም ነገር እንዳዘዘ የእስራኤል ልጆች የእህሉንና የወይኑን፥ የዘይቱንና የማሩንም፥ የእርሻውንም ፍሬ መጀመሪያ ሁሉ ሰጡ፤ የሁሉንም ዐሥራት አብዝተው አቀረቡ።
በይሁዳም ከተሞች የሚኖሩ የእስራኤልና የይሁዳ ልጆች የበሬዉንና የበጉን፥ የፍየሉንም ዐሥራት አመጡ፤ ለአምላካቸው ለእግዚአብሔርም ቀደሱት፤ ከምረውም አኖሩት።
በሦስተኛውም ወር መከመር ጀመሩ፤ በሰባተኛውም ወር ጨረሱ።
ሕዝቅያስና አለቆቹም መጥተው ክምሩን ባዩ ጊዜ እግዚአብሔርን አመሰገኑ። ሕዝቡን እስራኤልንም ባረኩ።
ሕዝቅያስም ካህናቱንና ሌዋውያኑን ስለ ክምሩ ጠየቀ።
ከሳዶቅም ወገን የሆነ ታላቁ ካህን ዓዛርያስ፥ “ሕዝቡ መባውን ወደ እግዚአብሔር ፊት ማቅረብ ከጀመረ ወዲህ በልተናል፤ ጠጥተናልም፤ ጠግበናልም፤ እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቡን ባርኮአልና ብዙ ተርፎአል፤ ከዚህም ገና ብዙ ተረፈ” ብሎ ተናገረ።
Hezekiah also commanded that the gates of the house of the Lord be prepared, and they prepared them.
They brought in the offerings and the tithes, and the consecrated things with faith to that place. The Levite also was appointed over them, and his brother Semai was the second in rank.

And King Hezekiah and the chief of the house of the Lord, Azariah, according to the command of Joel, and Azariah, and Anaiah, and Uzzah, and Iarimoth, and Jehozabad, and Eliel, and Semakiah, and Mahath, and the sons of Abijah, were under the hand of the Levites and their brother Semai, who were appointed to oversee.
The Levite, the son of Yimla, was appointed to oversee the offerings of the Lord and the consecrated things, that the people might bring them willingly to the Lord.

And the priests from their cities, for the great and the small, their brothers, were to give their portions in faith every week, Edom, Benaiah, Iyas, Semai, Amariah, and the Levites were under their hand.
And for those who were above thirty years old, every week for their work and their service, for every man who entered the house of the Lord, all the men,
In their father's house for the appointed priests, from above twenty years old, according to their divisions and every week for the appointed Levites,
And in all their communities, for every family appointed for their wives, for the men and for the women, their children were also given, for they were consecrated in faith.

The priesthood was appointed for the sons of Aaron, for the priests, and around their cities were the ministers, and in other cities for all the men, together with the Levites for the appointed people, they were all called by name.
And Hezekiah did thus throughout all Judah, and he did what was good and right and true before the Lord his God.
And concerning the service of the house of the Lord, in all the work that began, with the law and the commandment, the Lord God sought with a perfect heart; and all the work was accomplished.

sections.title: And it came to pass that the king of Assyria, Sennacherib, arose to go up against Jerusalem.

verses.text: ከእነዚህም ነገሮችና ከዚህ እውነት በኋላ የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም መጥቶ ወደ ይሁዳ ገባ፤ በተመሸጉትም ከተሞች ፊት ሰፈረ፤ ሊወስዳቸውም አሰበ።
ሕዝቅያስም ሰናክሬም እንደ መጣ፥ ኢየሩሳሌምንም ሊወጋ ፊቱን እንዳቀና አየ፤
ከከተማዪቱ በስተውጭ ያለውን የውኃውን ምንጭ ይደፍኑ ዘንድ ከአለቆቹና ከኀያላኑ ጋር ተማከረ፤ እነርሱም ምክሩን ወደዱ።
ብዙ ሰዎችንም ሰበሰበ፥ “የአሦርም ንጉሥ እንዳይመጣና ብዙ ውኃ አግኝቶ እንዳይጠነክር” ብሎ የውኃ ምንጮችንና በከተማዪቱ የሚፈስሱትን ወንዞች ደፈነ።
ሕዝቅያስም ሰውነቱን አጽናና፤ የፈረሰውንም ቅጥር ሁሉ ጠገነ፤ በላዩም ግንብ ሠራበት፤ ከእርሱም በስተውጭ ሌላ ቅጥር ሠራ፤ ወደ ዳዊትም ከተማ የሚያወጣውን በር አጠነከረ፤ ብዙም መሣሪያና ጋሻ አዘጋጀ።
የጦር አለቆቹንም በሕዝቡ ላይ ሾመ፤ ሁሉንም በሸለቆው በኩል ባለው በከተማዪቱ በር አደባባይ ወደ እርሱ ሰበሰበ፤ እንዲህም ብሎ ልባቸውን አጸና፦
“ጽኑ፥ አይዞአችሁ፤ ከእኛ ጋር ያለው ከእርሱ ጋር ካለው ይበልጣልና ከአሦር ንጉሥና ከእርሱ ጋር ካለው ጭፍራ ሁሉ የተነሣ አትፍሩ፤ አትደንግጡም።
ከእርሱ ጋር የሥጋ ክንድ ነው፤ ከእኛ ጋር ያለው ግን የሚረዳን የሚዋጋልንም አምላካችን እግዚአብሔር ነው።” ሕዝቡም በይሁዳ ንጉሥ በሕዝቅያስ ቃል ተጽናና።
ከዚህም በኋላ የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም ከሠራዊቱ ሁሉ ጋር በለኪሶ ፊት ሳለ ባሪያዎቹን ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ይሁዳ ንጉሥ ወደ ሕዝቅያስና በኢየሩሳሌም ወደ ነበሩ ወደ ይሁዳ ሕዝብ ሁሉ እንዲህ ሲል ላከ፦
“የአሦር ንጉሥ ሰናክሬም እንዲህ ይላል፦ እናንተ በማን ተማምናችሁ በኢየሩሳሌም ምሽግ ትቀመጣላችሁ?
Our God, the Lord, shall deliver us from the hand of the king of Assyria; for he shall give you a spirit of famine, of thirst, and of death, and shall not He who brings to remembrance Hezekiah?

Bow down before this altar; and upon it, let us pour out our supplications; for this Hezekiah is not the one who has gathered the people of Judah and the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and has destroyed the altars and the places of worship?
Do you not know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the earth? Have all the nations of the earth been able to deliver their lands from my hand?
Is there anyone among all the gods of the nations that can deliver his people from my hand? So, can your God deliver you from my hand, since your fathers have perished?

Now, do not let Hezekiah deceive you; neither let him make you trust in these words; do not believe him; for no god of all the nations and kingdoms has been able to deliver his people from my hand and from the hand of my fathers; how then shall your God deliver you from my hand?
And the servants also spoke many other words against the Lord God and against His servant Hezekiah.

And they spoke against the God of Israel, saying, “Let not the gods of the nations deliver their people from my hand; likewise, let not the God of Hezekiah deliver His people from my hand,” thus they wrote a letter.

To cause them to remove their fortifications and to take the city, they cried out in a loud voice in the language of the Hebrews to terrify and to trouble the people of Jerusalem who were on the wall.
As one speaks against the gods of the nations, so it was spoken against the God of Jerusalem.
The king Hezekiah and the prophet Isaiah, the son of Amoz, prayed concerning this matter and cried out to heaven.
እግዚአብሔርም መልአኩን ላከ፤ እርሱም ጽኑዓን ኀያላኑንና መሳፍንቱን አለቆቹንም ከአሦር ንጉሥ ሰፈር አጠፋ። የአሦርም ንጉሥ አፍሮ ወደ ሀገሩ ተመለሰ። ወደ አምላኩም ቤት በገባ ጊዜ ከወገቡ የወጡት ልጆቹ በዚያ በሰይፍ ገደሉት።
እግዚአብሔርም ሕዝቅያስንና በኢየሩሳሌም የሚኖሩትን ከአሦር ንጉሥ ከስናክሬም እጅና ከሁሉም እጅ አዳናቸው፤ በዙሪያቸውም ካለው ሁሉ አሳረፋቸው።
ብዙዎቹም ለእግዚአብሔር መባ ይዘው ወደ ኢየሩሳሌም ይመጡ ነበር፤ ለይሁዳም ንጉሥ ለሕዝቅያስ እጅ መንሻ ይሰጡ ነበር፤ እርሱም ከዚህ ነገር በኋላ በሕዝብ ሁሉ ፊት ከፍ ከፍ አለ።
በዚያም ወራት ሕዝቅያስ እስከ ሞት ድረስ ታመመ፤ ወደ እግዚአብሔርም ጸለየ፤ እርሱም ሰማው፤ ምልክትም ሰጠው።
ሕዝቅያስ ግን እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰጠው ቸርነት መጠን አላደረገም፤ ልቡም ኮራ፤ ስለዚህም በእርሱና በይሁዳ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም ላይ ቍጣ ሆነ።
ሕዝቅያስም በኢየሩሳሌም ከሚኖሩ ሰዎች ጋር ስለ ልቡ ኵራት ሰውነቱን አዋረደ፤ እግዚአብሔርም በሕዝቅያስ ዘመን ቍጣውን አላመጣባቸውም።
ለሕዝቅያስም እጅግ ብዙ ሀብትና ክብር ነበረው፤ ለብርና ለወርቅም፥ ለከበረው ዕንቍና ለሽቱው፥ ለጋሻውና ውድ ለሆነው ዕቃ ሁሉ ግምጃ ቤቶችን ሠራ።
ለእህልና ለወይን ጠጅም ለዘይትም ዕቃ ቤቶች፥ ለልዩ ልዩም እንስሳ ጋጥ፥ ለመንጎችም በረት ሠራ።
እግዚአብሔርም እጅግ ብዙ ጥሪት ሰጥቶት ነበርና ከተሞችን ለራሱ ሠራ፤ ብዙም የበግና የላም መንጋ ሰበሰበ።
ይህም ሕዝቅያስ የላይኛውን የግዮንን ውኃ ምንጭ ደፈነ፤ በዳዊትም ከተማ በምዕራብ በኩል አቅንቶ አወረደው። ሕዝቅያስም በሥራው ሁሉ ተከናወነ።

Nevertheless, the messengers of Babylon shall inquire concerning the wonders that have been done in his land; and when they are sent unto him, the Lord shall test him, that he may know all that is in his heart.
The matters concerning Hezekiah, indeed, his goodness, behold, they are written in the vision of Isaiah the prophet, the son of Amoz, in the book concerning the kings of Judah and Israel.

And Hezekiah slept with his fathers; and they buried him in the uppermost part of the sepulchres of the sons of David; and all the inhabitants of Judah and Jerusalem did him honor at his death. And his son Manasseh reigned in his stead.

sections.title: The reign of Manasseh, king of Judah.

verses.text: Manasseh was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-five years in Jerusalem.
And the Lord caused them to commit wickedness before Him, as the nations which the Lord had cast out before the children of Israel.
His father Hezekiah had restored the altars that had been broken down, and he made a house for the idols; he also constructed the abominable shrines, and he dedicated them to all the host of heaven.
And the Lord said, “My name shall remain in Jerusalem forever,” and he made altars for the idols in the house of the Lord.
And in the house of the Lord, he made altars for all the host of heaven at both the entrances.

And he made his sons pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; he practiced soothsaying and divination, and he dealt with familiar spirits and wizards; he committed much evil in the sight of the Lord, to provoke Him to anger.
And the Lord spoke to David and to his son Solomon, saying, “In this house and in Jerusalem, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, I will put My name forever;

and if you will keep all My commandments and My statutes and judgments which I have commanded you, and do them, then I will establish the throne of your kingdom as I covenanted with your father David, saying, ‘You shall not lack a man to sit on the throne of Israel.’”
Manasseh caused the children of Israel to sin more than the nations whom the Lord had destroyed before the children of Israel.
And the Lord spoke to Manasseh and to his people; but they would not listen.
ስለዚህም እግዚአብሔር የአሦርን ንጉሥ ሠራዊት አለቆች አመጣባቸው፤ ምናሴንም በዛንጅር ያዙት፤ በሰንሰለትም አስረው ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰዱት።
በተጨነቀም ጊዜ አምላኩን እግዚአብሔርን ፈለገ፤ በአባቶቹም አምላክ ፊት ሰውነቱን እጅግ አዋረደ።
የንጉሡ የሕዝቅያስ ልጅ ምናሴም ጸለየ እንዲህም አለ፦

sections.title: The Prayer of Manasseh

verses.text: “ዓለምን ሁሉ የምትገዛ፥
በቃልህ ትእዛዝ ባሕርን የገሠጽሃት፥
ይኸውም በተመሰገነው ስምህ ነው፤
ለክብርህ ከፍተኛነት ፍጻሜ የለውምና፥
በትእዛዝህ ለሚሆነው ይቅርታ ስፍር ቍጥር የለውም፤
አሁንም አቤቱ፥ የጻድቃን አምላካቸው አንተ ነህ።
ቍጥሩ ከባሕር አሸዋ የሚበልጥ በደልን በድያለሁና፥
ከንቱውን ስመለከት የማይጠቅመኝንም ነገር ሳበዛ
አሁንም ቸርነትህን እየለመንሁ በልቤ ጕልበት እሰግዳለሁ።
አቤቱ፥ ጌታዬ፥ ፈጽሜ በደልሁ፤
አንተንም እማልዳለሁ፤ እለምንህማለሁ፤
ለዘለዓለም ክፋቴን አትመልከትብኝ፤
በየጊዜውና በሕይወቴ ዘመን ሁሉ አመሰግንሃለሁ።
ከዚህ በኋላ በዳዊት ከተማ በስተውጭው ከግዮን ሰሜናዊ ምዕራብ በሸለቆው ውስጥ እስከ ዓሣ በር መግቢያ ድረስ ቅጥር ሠራ። እስከ ዖፌልም አዞረበት፤ እጅግም ከፍ አደረገው፤ በተመሸጉትም በይሁዳ ከተሞች ሁሉ የጭፍራ አለቆችን አኖረ።
እንግዶችንም አማልክትና ጣዖታቱንም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት አራቀ፤ የእግዚአብሔርም ቤት ባለበት ተራራ ላይና በኢየሩሳሌም የሠራቸውን መሠዊያዎች ሁሉ ወስዶ ከከተማዪቱ በስተውጭ ጣላቸው።
የእግዚአብሔርንም መሠዊያ ደግሞ አደሰ፤ የደኅነትንና የምስጋናንም መሥዋዕት ሠዋበት፤ የይሁዳም ሕዝብ የእስራኤልን አምላክ እግዚአብሔርን እንዲያመልኩ አዘዘ።
ሕዝቡ ግን ከአምላካቸው ከእግዚአብሔር ፈጽመው ርቀው ገና በኮረብታዎች ላይ ይሠዉ ነበር፥
የምናሴም የቀሩት ነገሮች፥ ወደ አምላኩም የጸለየው ጸሎት፥ በእስራኤልም አምላክ በእግዚአብሔር ስም የነገሩት የነቢያት ቃል፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤል ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል።
ደግሞም ጸሎቱን፥ እግዚአብሔር እንደ ሰማው፥ ኀጢአቱና መተላለፉ ሁሉ፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ሳይመለስ ኮረብታውን የሠራበት ዐፀዱንና የተቀረጹትንም ምስሎች የተከለበት ስፍራ፥ እነሆ፥ በባለ ራእዩ የታሪክ መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል።
ምናሴም ከአባቶቹ ጋር አንቀላፋ፤ በቤቱም አትክልት ቦታ ቀበሩት፤ ልጁም አሞጽ በእርሱ ፋንታ ነገሠ።
In the time when Amos began to prophesy, he was a shepherd of Tekoa, and he prophesied in Jerusalem for two years.
And his father Manasseh did evil in the sight of the Lord, as he had done; and Amos, like his father Manasseh, sacrificed to all the graven images which they had made, and he worshipped them.
His father Manasseh did not humble himself before the Lord, but Amos greatly multiplied his transgressions.
And the servants rose up against him; and they struck him in his own house.
But the people of the land rose up against all that Amos had prophesied; and the people of the land spoke against his son Josiah in his presence.

sections.title: The Reign of Josiah

verses.text: ኢዮስያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የስምንት ዓመት ልጅ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሠላሳ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ።
በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ቅን ነገር አደረገ፤ በአባቱም በዳዊት መንገድ ሄደ፤ ወደ ቀኝም ወደ ግራም አላለም።
በነገሠም በስምንተኛው ዓመት ገና ብላቴና ሳለ የአባቱን የዳዊትን አምላክ ይፈልግ ጀመረ፤ በዐሥራ ሁለተኛውም ዓመት ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምን ከኮረብታውና ከዐፀዶቹ፥ ከተቀረጹትና ቀልጠው ከተሠሩት ምስሎች ያነጻ ጀመር።
የበዓሊምንም መሠዊያዎች በፊቱ አፈረሰ፤ በላዩም የነበሩትን ኮረብታዎችን ዐፀዶቹንም ቈረጠ፤ የተቀረጹትንና ቀልጠው የተሠሩትንም ምስሎች ሰባበረ፤ አደቀቃቸውም፤ ይሠዉላቸው በነበሩት ሰዎች መቃብርም ላይ በተናቸው።
የካህኖቻቸውንም አጥንት በመሠዊያቸው ላይ አቃጠለ። ይሁዳንና ኢየሩሳሌምንም አነጻ።
የምናሴንና የኤፍሬምንም፥ የስምዖንና የንፍታሌምንም ከተሞች፥ በዙሪያቸውም ያለውን ቦታ እንዲሁ አነጻ።
መሠዊያዎቹንም አፈረሰ፤ የማምለኪያ ዐፀዶቹንና የተቀረጹትን ምስሎችም አደቀቀ፤ በእስራኤልም ሀገር ሁሉ የኮረብታዎችን መስገጃዎችአጠፋ። ወደ ኢየሩሳሌምም ተመለሰ።
በነገሠም በዐሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ምድሪቱንና የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ካነጻ በኋላ፥ የሴልያ ልጅ ሳፋን፥ የከተማዪቱም አለቃ መዕሴያ፥ ታሪክ ጸሓፊውም የኢዮአካዝ ልጅ ኢዮአክ የእግዚአብሔርን የአምላኩን ቤት ይጠግኑ ዘንድ ሰደዳቸው።
ወደ ታላቁም ካህን ወደ ኬልቅያስ መጡ፤ ሌዋውያኑም በረኞች ከምናሴና ከኤፍሬም፥ ከአለቆችም፥ ከቀረውም ከእስራኤል ሁሉ፥ ከይሁዳና ከብንያም ሁሉ በኢየሩሳሌምም ከሚኖሩት የሰበሰቡትን፥ ወደ እግዚአብሔር ቤት የቀረበውን ገንዘብ ሰጡት።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት በሚሠሩት ላይ ለተሾሙት ሰጡ፤ እነርሱም ይጠግኑና ያድሱ ዘንድ የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ለሚሠሩ ሠራተኞች ሰጡአቸው።

And the princes of Judah shall make for them houses of cedar, and for the purpose of preparation, they shall procure timber, and they shall give unto the laborers and unto the builders the stones that have been hewn.

And the people performed their work with diligence; and upon them were appointed the Levites who served, namely, the sons of Merari, namely, Ethan and Abdi; and from the sons of Kohath were Zechariah and Meshullam. And from among the Levites, all who were skilled in song were present.
And they were appointed over the bearers and over the various works that were performed; and the scribes and the rulers, and the porters, were of the sons of Levi.

sections.title: And the priest Hilkiah found the book of the law in the house of the Lord.

verses.text: And when they brought the money that was offered to the house of the Lord, the priest Hilkiah found the book of the law of the Lord, given by the hand of Moses.
And Hilkiah spoke to Shaphan the scribe, saying, "I have found the book of the law in the house of the Lord." And Hilkiah gave the book to Shaphan.

And Shaphan brought the book to the king; and he reported to the king, saying, "Your servants have gathered the money that was found in the house of the Lord, and have delivered it into the hand of those who do the work, who oversee the house of the Lord."
And they gave the money that was found in the house of the Lord to the workmen, and to the laborers, and they gave it into their hands.
And the scribe Shaphan told the king, saying, "Hilkiah the priest has given me a book." And Shaphan read it before the king.
And it came to pass, when the king heard the words of the law, that he tore his clothes.
And the king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah a servant of the king, saying:

"Go, inquire of the Lord for me, and for the people, and for all Judah, concerning the words of this book that has been found; for great is the wrath of the Lord that is poured out upon us, because our fathers have not kept the word of the Lord, to do according to all that is written in this book."

And Hilkiah and those whom the king had appointed went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe; now she dwelt in Jerusalem in the second quarter; and they spoke to her to that effect.
And she said to them, "Thus says the Lord God of Israel: Tell the man who sent you to me, saying,"

Thus saith the Lord God: Behold, I bring upon this place and upon them that dwell therein all the words that are written in the book which was read before the king of Judah, even the evil that I will bring upon them.
For they have forsaken Me and have burned incense unto other gods, and My anger shall be kindled against this place, and it shall not be quenched.
To inquire of the Lord, ye shall say unto your king, Thus saith the Lord God of Israel: Because thine heart was tender, and thou hast humbled thyself before the Lord.
Because thou hast rent thy clothes and wept before Me, I also have heard thee, saith the Lord.

Behold, I will gather thee unto thy fathers, and thou shalt be gathered to thy grave in peace; and thine eyes shall not see all the evil that I will bring upon this place, and upon the inhabitants thereof.
And the king sent, and they gathered unto him all the elders of Judah and of Jerusalem.

And the king went up to the house of the Lord, and all the men of Judah, and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great; and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of the Lord.

And the king stood by a pillar, and made a covenant before the Lord, to walk after the Lord, and to keep His commandments and His testimonies and His statutes with all their heart and all their soul, to perform the words of this covenant that were written in this book.
And all the people stood to the covenant.

And Josiah put away all the abominations out of all the countries that belonged to the children of Israel, and made all that were present in Israel to serve, even to serve the Lord their God. And all his days they departed not from following the Lord, the God of their fathers.

sections.title: King Josiah kept the Passover feast unto the Lord as it was commanded.

verses.text: And Josiah made the Passover unto the Lord, to the God of Israel, in Jerusalem; in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, they kept the Passover.
And he appointed the priests according to their divisions, and they were to serve in the house of the Lord.

And in all Israel, he commanded the Levites to purify themselves for the Lord, and that they should dwell in the house of the Lord, which is the Ark of the Covenant of Israel, the son of David, Solomon, in the house he built. And the king Josiah said, "Let nothing be carried in your burdens; now serve your God, the Lord, and the people of Israel."
As David, the king of Israel, commanded, so his son Solomon commanded, that they should prepare themselves in their weeks and in the houses of their fathers.

Like the children of the people, as your brethren, in the houses of their fathers, let them be distributed in the sanctuary; likewise, let there be distribution for the Levites in the houses of their fathers.
And they prepared the Passover; and you shall be sanctified, and you shall do according to the word which the Lord spoke by the hand of Moses, to prepare for your brethren."

And Josiah gave for the Passover offerings to those who were present, to the children of the people, from the flock thirty thousand lambs and kids, and three thousand calves; these were of the king's substance.

And the rulers gave for the people and for the priests, and for the Levites, according to their command; and the rulers of the house of the Lord, Hilkiah, Zechariah, and Jehiel, gave for the Passover offerings to be two thousand six hundred sheep and goats, and three hundred oxen for the priests.

And the Levite rulers, Conaniah and his brethren, and the sons of the Levites, Shemaiah and Nethanel, and his brethren, gave for the Passover offerings to be five thousand sheep and goats, and five hundred oxen for the Levites.
And the service was prepared; and the priests stood in their places, and the Levites in their divisions, according to the command of the king.
የፋሲካውንም በግ አረዱ፤ ካህናቱም ከእጃቸው የተቀበሉትን ደም ረጩ፤ ሌዋውያኑም ቍርበቱን ገፈፉ።
በሙሴም መጽሐፍ እንደ ተጻፈ ለእግዚአብሔር ያቀርቡ ዘንድ በየአባቶቻቸው ቤቶች እንደ ክፍላቸው ለሕዝቡ ልጆች እንዲሰጡ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ለዩ። እንዲሁም በበሬዎቹ አደረጉ።
የፋሲካውንም በግ እንደ ሙሴ ሥርዐት በእሳት ጠበሱ፤ የተቀደሰውንም ቍርባን በምንቸትና በሰታቴ፥ በድስትም ቀቀሉ፤ ተከናወነላቸውም፤ ለሕዝቡም ልጆች ሁሉ በፍጥነት አደረሱ።
ከዚያም በኋላ ለራሳቸውና ከእነርሱ ጋር ላሉ ለካህናቱ አዘጋጁ፤ የአሮንም ልጆች ካህናቱ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕትና ስቡን ለማቅረብ እስከ ሌሊት ድረስ ይሠሩ ነበርና ስለዚህ ሌዋውያን ለራሳቸውና ለወንድሞቻቸው ለአሮን ልጆች ለካህናቱ አዘጋጁ።
የአሳፍም ልጆች መዘምራን እንደ ዳዊት፥ እንደ አሳፍም፥ እንደ ኤማንም የንጉሡም ባለ ራእይ እንደ ነበረው እንደ ኤዶትም ትእዛዝ በየስፍራቸው ነበሩ፤ በረኞቹም በሮቹን ሁሉ ይጠብቁ ነበር፤ ወንድሞቻቸውም ሌዋውያን ያዘጋጁላቸው ነበርና ከአገልግሎታቸው ይርቁ ዘንድ አያስፈልጋቸውም ነበር።
እንደ ንጉሡም እንደ ኢዮስያስ ትእዛዝ በእግዚአብሔር መሠዊያ ላይ የሚቃጠለውን መሥዋዕት ያቀርቡ ዘንድ፥ ፋሲካውንም ያደርጉ ዘንድ፥ የእግዚአብሔር አገልግሎት ሁሉ በዚያ ቀን ተዘጋጀ።
የተገኙትም የእስራኤል ልጆች በዚያ ቀን ፋሲካውን፥ ሰባት ቀንም የቂጣውን በዓል አደረጉ።
ከነቢዩም ከሳሙኤል ዘመን ጀምሮ እንደዚህ ያለ ፋሲካ በእስራኤል ዘንድ ከቶ አልተደረገም፤ ከእስራኤልም ነገሥታት ሁሉ ኢዮስያስና ካህናቱ፥ ሌዋውያኑም፥ በዚያም የተገኙ የይሁዳና የእስራኤል ሰዎች ሁሉ፥ በኢየሩሳሌምም የሚኖሩት እንዳደረጉት ያለ ፋሲካ ያደረገ የለም።
ይህም ፋሲካ ኢዮስያስ በነገሠ በዐሥራ ስምንተኛው ዓመት ተደረገ።
ከዚህም ሁሉ በኋላ፥ ኢዮስያስም ቤተ መቅደሱን ካሰናዳ በኋላ፥ የግብጽ ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ በኤፍራጥስ ወንዝ አጠገብ የአሦርን ንጉሥ ይዋጋ ዘንድ ወጣ፤ ኢዮስያስም ሊጋጠመው ወጣ።

And he said, "O King of Judah, what have I to do with thee? I come not this day to thee, but to the house of another; for the Lord hath commanded me to be grieved; take heed that the Lord thy God destroy thee not, for he is with me." Thus he sent messengers unto him.
Yet Josiah did not turn his face toward him, but he was strong in his resolve; and the word that was spoken by the mouth of the Lord he did not heed; and he came to battle in Megiddo.
And the archers shot at King Josiah; and the king said to his servants, "Take me away; for I am sore wounded."

So the servants took him out of the chariot and put him in the second chariot that he had; and they brought him to Jerusalem. And he died there, and was buried in the sepulcher of his fathers; and all Judah and Jerusalem mourned for Josiah.

Jeremiah also lamented for Josiah; and to this day all the singing men and the singing women speak of Josiah in their lamentations; and it became a custom in Israel, and they are written in the lamentations.
Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and his goodness, according to that which was written in the law of the Lord, are they not written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?
The first and the last of the matters, behold, they are written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Israel and Judah.

sections.title: The Reign of Jehoiakim

verses.text: የሀገሩም ሰዎች የኢዮስያስን ልጅ ኢዮአክስን ወስደው በአባቱ ፋንታ በኢየሩሳሌም አነገሡት።
ኢዮአክስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ ሦስት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወር ነገሠ። 2 ‘ሀ’ የእናቱም ስም ከሎቤና የኤርምያስ ልጅ አሚጣል ነበረች። 2 ‘ለ’ አባቶቹ እንደ ሠሩት ሁሉ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ ሥራን ሠራ። በኢየሩሳሌምም እንዳይነግሥ በኤማት ምድር በዴብላታ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ ማርኮ አሰረው።
ንጉሡም ወደ ግብፅ ወሰደው፤ በሀገሩም ላይ መቶ መክሊት ብርና አንድ መክሊት ወርቅ ግብር ጣለበት።

የግብፅም ንጉሥ ፈርዖን ኒካዑ የይሁዳን ንጉሥ የኢዮስያስን ልጅ ኤልያቄምን በአባቱ ፋንታ በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አነገሠ፤ ስሙንም ኢዮአቄም ብሎ ለወጠ፤ ፈርዖን ኒካዑም ወንድሙን ኢዮአክስን ይዞ ወደ ግብፅ ወሰደው። በዚያም ሞተ። 4 ‘ሀ’ ወርቅንና ብርን ለፈርዖን ሰጠ። በዚያን ጊዜም ምድር በፈርዖን ትእዛዝ ብር መገበሯን ጀመረች። 4 ‘ለ’ እያንዳንዱም እንደሚችለው ለፈርዖን ኒካዑ እንዲገብር ከሀገሪቱ ሕዝብ ወርቅንና ብርን ጠየቀ።

ኢዮአቄምም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ አምስት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ዐሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ፤ እናቱም ዘካራ የምትባል የኔሬያሳ ልጅ የራማ ሴት ነበረች፤ አባቶቹም እንዳደረጉ በአምላኩ በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ። 5 ‘ሀ’ በእነዚያም ወራት የባቢሎን ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር ወደዚያ ሀገር መጣና ሦስት ዓመት ተገዛለት። ከእርሱም ከዳ።
የባቢሎንም ንጉሥ ናቡከደነፆር በእርሱ ላይ ወጥቶ ወደ ባቢሎን ይወስደው ዘንድ በሰንሰለት አሰረው።
ናቡከደነፆርም ከእግዚአብሔር ቤት ዕቃ አያሌውን አውጥቶ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰደ፤ በባቢሎንም በጣዖቱ ቤት ውስጥ አኖረው።
የቀሩትም የኢዮአቄም ነገሮች፥ ያደረገውም ርኵሰት፥ በእርሱም የተገኘው ሁሉ፥ እነሆ፥ በእስራኤልና በይሁዳ ነገሥታት መጽሐፍ ተጽፈዋል፤ ኢዮአቄምም እንደ አባቶቹ አንቀላፋ፤ ከአባቶቹም ጋር በጋኖዛን ከተማ ተቀበረ። ልጁም ኢኮንያን ከእርሱ ቀጥሎ ነገሠ።
ኢኮንያንም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የዐሥራ ስምንት ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ሦስት ወር ከዐሥር ቀን ነገሠ፤ በእግዚአብሔርም ፊት ክፉ አደረገ።
ዓመቱም ባለፈ ጊዜ ንጉሡ ናቡከደነፆር ልኮ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰደው፤ የከበረውንም የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት ዕቃ ከእርሱ ጋር አስወሰደ፤ የአባቱን የኢዮአቄምን ወንድም ሴዴቅያስን በይሁዳና በኢየሩሳሌም ላይ አነገሠ።
ሴዴቅያስም መንገሥ በጀመረ ጊዜ የሃያ አንድ ዓመት ጐልማሳ ነበረ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ዐሥራ አንድ ዓመት ነገሠ።
በአምላኩም በእግዚአብሔር ፊት ክፉ አደረገ፤ ከነቢዩ ከኤርምያስ ፊት፥ ከእግዚአብሔርም ቃል የተነሣ አላፈረም።
ደግሞም በእግዚአብሔር ስም አምሎት በነበረው በንጉሡ በናቡከደነፆር ላይ ዐመፀ፤ ወደ እስራኤልም አምላክ ወደ እግዚአብሔር እንዳይመለስ አንገቱን አደነደነ፤ ልቡንም አጠነከረ።
የይሁዳም ታላላቅ ሰዎች ካህናቱና የሀገሩም ሕዝብ በአሕዛብ ርኵሰት ሁሉ መተላለፍን አበዙ፤ በኢየሩሳሌምም ያለውን የእግዚአብሔርን ቤት አረከሱ።
የአባቶቻቸውም አምላክ እግዚአብሔር ለሕዝቡና ለማደሪያው ስላዘነ ማለዳ ተነሥቶ በነቢያቱ እጅ ወደ እነርሱ ይልክ ነበር።
እነርሱ ግን የእግዚአብሔር ቍጣ በሕዝቡ ላይ እስኪወጣ ድረስ፥ ፈውስም እስከማይገኝላቸው ድረስ፥ በእግዚአብሔር መልእክተኞች ይሳለቁ፥ ቃሉንም ያቃልሉ፥ በነቢያቱም ላይ ያፌዙ ነበር።
ስለዚህም የከለዳውያንን ንጉሥ አመጣባቸው፤ እርሱም ጐልማሶቻቸውን በቤተ መቅደሱ ውስጥ በሰይፍ ገደላቸው፤ለንጉሣቸው ለሴዴቅያስም አልራራለትም፤ ደናግሉንም አልማረም፤ ሽማግሌዎቻቸውንም ወሰዳቸው፤ ሁሉንም እግዚአብሔር በእጁ አሳልፎ ሰጠው።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት ዕቃ ሁሉ፥ ታላቁንና ታናሹን፥ የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤት መዝገብ፥ የንጉሡንም ቤት መዝገብ፥ የአለቆቹንም ቤት መዝገብ፥ እነዚህን ሁሉ ወደ ባቢሎን ወሰደ።
የእግዚአብሔርንም ቤተ መቅደስ አቃጠለ፤ የኢየሩሳሌምንም ቅጥር አፈረሰ፤ አዳራሾችዋንም በእሳት አቃጠለ፤ መልካሙንም ዕቃዋን ሁሉ አጠፋ።
የተረፉትንም ወደ ባቢሎን ማረካቸው፤ የሜዶንም ንጉሥ እስኪነግሥ ድረስ ለንጉሡና ለልጆቹ ባሪያዎች ሆኑ፤

The word of the Lord which was spoken by the mouth of Jeremiah, that it might be fulfilled, until the land should observe the Sabbath, until it should be desolate, and during all the time it was desolate, it kept the Sabbath for seventy years.

And it came to pass, when the word of the Lord which was spoken by Jeremiah was fulfilled, that in the first year of Cyrus king of Persia, the Lord stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Persia, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and put it also in writing, saying thus:

"Thus says Cyrus king of Persia: All the kingdoms of the earth has the Lord God of heaven given me; and he has charged me to build him a house at Jerusalem, which is in Judah. Who is there among you of all his people? The Lord his God be with him, and let him go up."
